text: First, I really like the many aquariums, adventures and match 3 puzzles. I have spent some money to get energy for the adventures when I get stuck on a hard puzzle. Second, I am disappointed that the fish eating everything and growing game is not anywhere In Fishdome. They should change the app picture and ads. I kept this game on my phone because I liked that plot, but I have yet to encounter it.

I've been playing this game since it hit Big Fish on PC in 2008. The game itself plays basically the same but now it's inundated with microtransactions and cards and teams and other dumb stuff which has totally ruined it. Even the fish in my aquariums are telling me to buy, buy, buy. They used to be fun. Now they're just salesmen. Absolutely ridiculous. No thanks. I miss the days where you bought a game once and the devs weren't trying to nickel & dime you every time you try and play.

Doesn't play as shown in the ad. Why? That game would be really fun. The bonus game never really changes and it's about moving levers to get the fish food to the fish. It's very simple and boring, since it never gets harder. The main game is better and the adventure & side games are fun. Still don't understand why they don't advertise the real game. The hard levels require you to purchase credits to get farther, but there's a lot of free play with this game.

Been playing for 2 years. Now it's turned into a money grab. I used to get a reliable gem every time I fed my fish. Now, lucky if I get one a day. power-ups disappear randomly during play. "Deals" pop up during timed bonus play, delaying your chances to benefit from bonuses. Forced claim of prizes is another new glitch. Customer service is NOT responsive. I've spent far too much $$. I would quit if I wasn't on a team; considering to delete the app. Too frustrating, not enough enjoyment.

Update: This game needs serious error improvement. I don't like the things disappearing randomly. While playing in a timed event. it wouldn't allow payment. insufficient funds Google play shows one balance. Fishdom shows $1 in Google Play. Since the recent update, bombs aren't as effective. What formerly took one move to finish. It leaves one block. Today, I ran out of diamonds in the middle of one hour of unlimited help. I spent too much money for too many errors.

I've had this get for a long time. I used to LOVE this game. the mingames would change every so often and there were always lots of ways to earn extra powerups to use in the main game itself. but over the years it's changed a lot and now there are way less options for getting them. Definitely makes you want to pay more often in order to be able to advance levels. I also really miss the matching mini game. now its only the quests, which makes you do a new tutorial every time it changes the story

This used to be a fun game. Graphics are great and good diversity in levels. But, with the latest updates players are leaving. Levels are now not just super hard but impossible to beat without using diamonds. Ok, not such a big deal but you now get fewer diamonds for the same $. This game is no longer focused on player experience and with that, making money. It is now just a money grab. And some players get booster activities while others don't. Support is lacking at best.

once you get past the beginner levels, you essentially have to pay to play. levels, even the green ones, are too difficult to pass without using multiple tools, gems for continued play, etc. I've only had this game a week and it's become too frustrating to play since lives take a very long time to renew and you have to have hundreds of tools or gems to continue to pass level after level. not worth it.

the only good thing is that there aren't ads. once you've been playing for a while the levels become so ridiculously hard that it is no longer relaxing only frustrating. unless of course you "buy" extra moves or boosters. also when you would win a level, suddenly the boosters or the game play doesn't work as it should. wouldn't recommend.

I enjoy the game very much especially some of the upgrades. However if I buy a pack of 250 rubies, it will ensure i use the rubies so fast, expect me to buy more rubies 5 minutes later. Which is counterintuitive for them. At that point I can't afford to buy anymore (unless I don't pay my bills) and have to stop playing for several days therefore I'm no longer spending money in the game. I know the point of the game is to make money but better to get a little bit consistently than none at all

I love the fact that there was actual thought put into this game, like there are no ads, at least when I play, then all the levels are fun. how they interduce new things to the player is awesome and the fact there's a lot of ways you can use coins and get coins are SO SO fun and cool. I love that you can decorate the starting area to, 5 out of 5 game to try it now.

I can't send 7 of my teammates any cards because they don't appear in the list for sending cards. This negatively affects every teammate by preventing a large percentage of our players from completing bonus games and winning tools to help the team in events. This has been going on for weeks with little to no response from support. There has been no compensation to allow for the disruption of this feature.

After this recent update. Im done. And Ive played for years. They've now made levels even more difficult and lowered the rewards. Not worth playing anymore and Ive spent quite a bit of money on this game. When you make a game this difficult, with little to no payout, what do you think is going to happen?

Fun to play. enjoy the smoothness and the graphics. I did uninstall the game for a long while then re-download it. which made me remember why I removed it. Unless you spend money, it is next to impossible to pass levels and I created a team then got removed as the leader which made me mad because I created the team. So found a team, took me a couple of trys. Joined the team and Im not allowed to participate in the team challenges. Not quite sure if im going to completely uninstall for good.

Fun colorful, beautiful game.Downsides is if you want to advance you'd have to spend money for purple diamonds and power ups. $500 in 4 months, it added up real quick. My biggest problem with the game is the inability to save the unlimited lives for later when I have time to play a whole hour. Another annoying feature is when unlimited lives expire during game play it takes a life. The levels are getting harder and harder.

I'm giving it a one-star because of support. I've contacted support too many times of not being able to receive cards because they are not seen by other team members. Only resonse is from AI, and it's a known issue. There are 7 members of my team that are unseen to send cards to. I lost 180 gems and my super booster trying to get enough cards to finish hit the target this last weekend without team help. Please respond with an actual member from the development team

Just what I was looking for! When I'm in too good of a mood, I just replay the same 19 move level that really takes around 30, over and over again! And Playrix is so nice, they offer to sell you an extra 35 moves every time you fail! I keep a crumpled up piece of paper next to me to throw across the room instead of my phone, this way the game can ruin my mood but not my phone!

what used to be a fun, enjoyable game has become so annoying to play after recent updates. I spend hours and often days trying to clear a single level, and as soon as I clear 10 levels to get the super lightening, I immediately lose it unless I spend money. This game is no longer fun or enjoyable. Also, support doesn't respond and just closes conversations. If I could give a negative star rating I would. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS GAME! THE MORE YOU SPEND, THE MORE IMPOSSIBLE THEY MAKE IT.

THERE'S NO ADS!! that being said... they have to make money somehow, which they do with levels you can't beat without buying powerups or extra diamonds to buy additional moves. so be aware of this fact before you decide to play. now the game is fun and i enjoyed the time on it but advancing in the higher levels won't happen unless you spend money. and this fact is proven as I have been stuck on the level 789 for over a week and a half. sadly this will be the second playrix game I'm uninstalling.

It's impossible to continue playing without spending money. They have priced themself out of business! This game used to be more fun than Candy Crush & you got to have fish tanks! Now, there are so many side challenges, cards & games that you have to play in order to get your tools for the original game! It's almost impossible to achieve any of the required goals anyway! It is all about getting you to spend money! They have killed the fun & left you feeling inadequate at achieving any goals! Sad

I have been playing for a long time and enjoyed the game, especially the aquariums and seasonal events. After the latest update, my special event aquariums (Christmas, Easter, Halloween, etc.) disappeared, along with decorations and items I had already unlocked. This is very frustrating, as I invested time to earn them. I ask for clarification and transparency about this change and request that the seasonal aquariums and previously earned items be restored.

I have been playing this game since the beginning and I loved it until recently. I am currently over level 15000. The game has changed!! I am thinking about not playing anymore. The levels are next to impossible and frustrating to use up all your lives and have to wait several hours to play again!! It is all about making you spend money!! 10 20 dollars at a time! Even bonus games are frustrating. You get less product for more money!! Capitalism at its worse!!

I've been playing this game off and on for over 10 years. Previously, it was simple. Decorate your tank, play simple games, clean and feed the fish, etc. Now the screen is covered with whatever "season" or "challenge" is running. You're also forced to click through every single one. It's so frustrating and the game is no longer fun, nor has the charm it previously did. I'm disappointed in the direction the creator/company has gone in.

My thoughts on Fishdom.., This game was interesting, I understand as I cont; playing this is an pay-to-play game only. I don't mind spending money on a game, I just don't think any games should charge a person, until you play the game a little bit, Give you a chance to make a decision on if you're going to keep it. The prices shouldn't be advertised the whole time. Shouldn't False advertise, this is nothing like the advertisement.

This is my most favorite game. Challenging, colorfull and just pure fun! ...that was 2019, it's 2026. It's challenging. it's colorful, I like it. What bothers me is the $9.99 price tag for the passes. The price doubled, and I never see half-price specials. If you need to complete challenges, you have to play in expeditions. Those stories are written for 5 yr olds as well as the tapping for points. Cards, "jump the shark" moment for Fishdom. Bring back what players begged for. Make it affordable.

bring back the hand!!! it's a very important tool in winning specific levels. from what I read just now I'm not the only one who agrees. also some specials and offeres would be really nice. I calculated how much I've spent and it's almost $100 since i started playing I'm November. I'm doing it for points and now if I don't spend a few more dollars there will ne no way I will finish and get the rest of the points needed so that's that..... bring back thr hand!!

Good game, but it gets too difficult. I spent 70 dollars and after a small run, I end up stuck on certain levels for hours to days. We don't have money to spend every time we want to level up. Haven't you seen the cost of living lately? Stop being so money hungry. It takes the fun out of the game and make us not want to play anymore. If you give more power ups and less times for lives to renew so that it can still be worth playing, people will still spend money on their own time.

I started playing this a long time ago, left because I didn't have a computer. came back because I had friends that pushed me to. found no progress from my old account transfered. restarted from 0 . though eh the game isn't bad. but you start noticing you will get stuck on a certain level, sometimes for days at a time making it feel like they want you to pay. if you want to play on more than one device, you will loose items that took days to earn, admins won't help you get your items back.

having fun? it won't last. If you do too well, the game will "mysteriously" drop pieces in ways that make it impossible to get in game power-ups and you'll lose. You'll use all your resources (both pre- and in-game) and still lose. Then, if you actually buy something, the puzzle pieces magically go back to dropping in beneficial ways! funny how that works! play if you're cool with ponying up some cash on a weekly basis, otherwise you're just wasting time on a rigged game

This game used to be fun, but I can no longer in good conscience recommend this game to anyone. The game simply cheats too much. In effort to combat really good, experienced players they've made the game just too hard. The game lies about the level difficulty. There seem to be less moves per game. Every update makes the game worse. The game just plays in a wierd way so you lose way too often or have to spend all the bonuses you just won. Avoid this game

here we are just another game just like the rest. Fun at first until you reach a higher level. I get challenges get more difficult but ive been stuck on the same level for far too long with 1 stupid box to get but of course no way to get it. Unless I pay! Surely I cant be the only person here that hates spending real money just to level up on a game. Thats cheating. Im fed up with games that only let you succeed if you cheat!

Zero customer service. Beautiful and fun game. Glitches made me lose items. I had the cats and the puppies which cost a lot of my time to aquire. Just upped and disappeared one day. Reached out to the developer and no response. I spent quite a bit of money on this game, the least they could do is respond. There were also times I paid for items and didn't get them.

the only thing good about this game is the teamwork. at least the team I'm on. past that, this last upgrade ruined the game. it took the good boosters away and added in more repeat levels. I find it 100% ridiculous that I can get stuck on an easy/normal level for DAYS using countless lives. this game has a knack for moving pieces the opposite way you want them to go, typically leaving you 1 move left and a loosing game. feels like a $ grab for diamonds. I'm not the only one either.

Sorry. Started ok, but after a few minutes, it wouldn't do anything other than point at a profile icon in the settings & wouldn't let me exit. No buttons & tabs of the whole box would work, not even hhe profile setting, etc. My phone is a newer Android phone, has updated apps, functions & I had just barely downloaded this app a bit ago, but keep trying to get it to work right. I think at another time, I had also downloaded this app, months ago & had issues on a previous Android phone

the game started out great, but then it changed. I know games tend to get harder as you play, but this is a joke. All of the sudden, ALL the levels are ridiculously hard, and you're using all your lives then have to wait hours to play again, and you can't get enough diamonds to do anything, and then if you want to buy them, it's so expensive! I'm disappointed. I'll probably be deleting.

As a long time player, this newest update has absolutely ruined the game for the sake of using gems more to extend levels, so you can make more money on in app purchases. I understand the need to keep things fresh or giving your staff something to do, but getting rid of bombs and the ability to move a piece over one spot has made this game instantly not fun. I admittedly was fine spending probably around $20+ a month cause I enjoyed it, but you've lost me as a player and my money with it.

PROS: Overall a fun game! Levels don't take long. Can hop on for only a minute or sit down and grind for a while. Love that your team can help each other. CONS: The weekend team vs team seems impossible to ever actually win. Wish we'd verse players on a similar level once in a while so it felt like there was a chance. Also the Treasure Island & Hit The Target combo is also straight unwinnable if 2 of your 3 partners just don't play. Repeating weekend letdown since you're just stuck together

Levels are way too hard to beat without powerups, and those don't always help. Game has become a money grab. Collections are almost impossible to complete without buying the jewel pass. Gold cards have gotten much harder to get, and I've opened multiple packs that are supposed to be giving gold cards and haven't gotten any. The new powerups suck and don't help much. Need to bring back if nothing else the glove powerup. Removing it just made it harder to try to make people spend money for levels.

Atlantis League is a terrible sales tactic. Some stages take forever to pass, these are the ones they include in the league. The ones where you had no other option but to spend money for diamonds or use the specials to pass them....yeah those stages. I HATE IT. When Atlantis is activated, I will tune the game out for the 4-6days. I HATE THE LEAGUE. Also, terrible of you crooks to increase the costs of decorating items and fishes, when the cash reward is so low.

I used to play this Daily throughout the day, but lately only play occasionally because it's damn nearly impossible lately to get past a level, so not as much fun anymore. Make it Too Difficult to succeed and it's just not a satisfying to play anymore... Used to be I could get through a level within 1 to a few days, now I'm stuck on a level for Weeks, so makes me want to play Less...

Jan 26 Treasure Island is the worst mini game have ever had. Just saying. Great game, slightly misleading- haven't been any mini games in a while. I'm also very disappointed that the cost for the season went up but the length went down. Not a cool move. I don't mind supporting games that I enjoy, but it's rude to charge more for less. Overall, though, I enjoy the game and the different seasons and expeditions.

I feel like this was a bait and switch. The advertisement showed it as a game that you gather fish, sell them, and upgrade your machinery, etc... it is not that at all. That is just a little side game of the main game which is just another match 3 game. So disappointed. Uninstalling.

it helps kill down time. makes you think a little on which moves to make to achieve the level. the frustrating part is how long it takes to generate a life. also the levels requiring you to collect a certain amount of color to reveal the task behind it but they don't provide you with anything but that color makes it very frustrating. how am I supposed to collect xxx amount of reds when I get an abundance of other colors and a few reds to try and match? I don't have unlimited moves to make

Deleted this game years ago because of the monetizing getting out of control, then it was installed along with 4 other games as part of a "necessary UI update" from Samsung so decided to give it another chance. The monetizing is worse than ever. Constantly pressuring to buy your way forward and now stuck on the same level after 50+ attempts with the strong suggestion to buy gems or boosters. Deleting again for good this time.

game is really fun and well made but ultimately a scam at some point. I can't prove it but it feels like the algorithm is made for your luck to run out until you pay for power ups. other people feel the same thing happen. once I make a purchase the same magically increases in luck and I can pass the level I was stuck on (without using the power ups I paid for I will add). so play the early game and enjoy how great the game is but drop the game like a bad habit once you get further and get stuck

the ads are not true to the game. It is fun as long as you have the money to keep playing. At first you win quite a bit, but then it starts getting very difficult, even with the "easier" levels. so many times I got down to one bubble, or square left, the tiles slow down on the last move. Also, I made a purchase, and did not get the items. I tried the automated help and support,I couldn't clip the receipt.

I have played a lot of match 3 games, and Playrix is generally pretty good with them. With this one, though, they have taken away match 3 mechanics with special pieces that make them fun. No combining, nothing that goes a distance, and power balls are made by a gauge and dropped randomly, so most strategy is out the window. You're relying on luck way more than other m3 games. Everything else is exactly the same as their other games, so why take away tried & true fun & functionality elsewhere?

You can't win without spending money. I enjoyed the game, my wonderful team, and fish tanks, but I had to leave the game. You can't win without spending money. Without spending you are stuck on the same level for a very long time. I played for the enjoyment but I just can't keep playing one level over and over and never getting anywhere. I had to leave and delete the game.

The recent Fishdom updates have disabled past holiday, seasonal, and special event aquariums, along with their unique decorations and fish. The ability to be able to move pieces with the glove is gone too. Disappointed to see them gone. Levels are harder to complete, and moves allowed are less. Even if you use all your boosters, you still can't complete your level many times. Being stuck on a level for days ar even weeks makes one get discouraged and play less, not more.

Final update...This game is really fun, for a while. Then the difficulty ramps up so much that it becomes almost unplayable. Even regular levels become a grind with no control over what drops. You spend a day or more on 1 level and when past it you spend the same amount of time on the next level. Why even have events? You don't stand a chance when stuck on levels. The answer is simple. They want lots of your money. I pay because I like a game not to advance because it's artificially difficult.

I enjoy playing the game. I already recognize it's going to be no different than any "in purchase apps" kind of game. Eventually it costs a fourteener. I will uninstall it when it becomes that for me. It doesn't give enough gems... Always just a little short, to buy continuance. Then, the "continue" is 5 turns. It ultimately becomes unaffordable to play. Forewarned is forearmed. No one wants you to play for free. That's fair enough. But these games get expensive. Your dollars, Their pocket.

Update: May 2025. It has gotten worse! I'm ready to quit. I really like this game, but it's frustrating to play the same level 50 times without clearing it. Be prepared to spend a lot to proceed through the levels. Too hard and expensive since upgrade. Have been playing 7 years of with Gold Ticket about once a month. Now it's 2 to 3 times a month. Disappointing.

I've been playing this game over a year and I enjoyed it. I thought the fish tanks were cute. I beat multiple levels each day. if I was stuck on a level it was only for a short while. they've recently revamped the game. limited the number of power-ups you can use in each game. Now I can't get any where, even with power-ups! if you aren't winning, you aren't earning points, coins or power-ups. I don't normally like leaving reviews but I'm really frustrated and will be uninstalling this game.

*UPDATE* This was once a great game. Now, it's near impossible to beat levels without spending money and all the power ups. Also, the golden pass isn't worth it anymore! Bring back the 30 day pass! I've played more than 6000 levels but too many changes ruined it! Just like sooo many others have said.. Make it worth while to play and we will play again! Unistalled!

I bought a gold pass only to have it taken away. I've asked and emailed and no one has tried helping. Don't play this game. It's not worth it. Way too many bugs! I really like the game but it costs too much to keep playing. Not too mention you make it look like you can play mini games, but I rarely see them. But your characters are adorable. Love the little squids... too cute

This game isn"t what"s advertised. The advertisement showed helping fish get through a series of obstacles. So I installed it. But it is just matching 3 or more pieces with powerups like candy crush. Don't install if you want the game advertised. This isn't it. I was hoping it was a level thing but it's not. The ads are false advertising 😡

So i just looked up the level I'm stuck on on U Tube and all entries show 35 moves as a hard level. In reality I have 15 moves, Nothing like the ad, it's a match three game. You might get one of the depicted mini games once in 10 or so levels. And when you do it's like 3 simple moves and back to the normal match 3 game. If your not a paying player don't waste your time, you will get stuck on a level for sometimes a week at a time or more. Just plain sucks after you pass a certain level.

I am one of those people who saw an interesting ad for this game, involving fish eating other fish to get bigger. However, upon downloading and playing this game I quickly learned that it is predominantly a match three style game. The ad I had witnessed is one that was one of several mini games, and not one that I've actually been able to play yet, so I don't know how often I would be able to play that one, or, as I've heard, whatever be able to play again once progressing past a certain stage.

This would be the picture used beside the word "false advertising" in a dictionary. I've seen ads for this game for years and they only show clips and pictures of "fish with numbers eating other fish with smaller numbers to grow to continue." But in reality, it's a typical puzzle game and the fish eating fish is just a minigame. There's a million other puzzle games just like this one. You simply swipe to match the colours. There's nothing special about this game

I used to enjoy this game, and look forward to playing, especially the team challenges. Recently, with the gold pass lasting only one week instead of 27 days for the same price, the boring play with no challenges to complete, and the repetitive side games with minimal reward, I changed my rating from 4 to 1. The only thing that keeps me from deleting it is my team. We are very good at giving each other lives so at least we can play for a while without having to buy diamonds every single week.

Deleted within 3-4 hours. Why would you advertise only the 'minigame' part of the game when we barely get to play that? Who does that? The minigame should be the whole game. We want to play that. I only played the minigame with the keys sliding TWICE. It's mostly just match shapes, decide if you want to buy something, then go back to another round of matching shapes. It's boring. They wanted me to pay actual money or else I couldn't advance, but obviously it was not worth it.

Eventually, the game gets so hard, and changes the rules without giving notice, that you will need to spend money every day to pass levels. So, play for a while, DON'T PAY, and then walk away before you are spending 1 or 3 dollars a day. I blew through all my game credits, like $10, and cannot beat the current level. It adds up fast. I paid a few dollars here and there but this game is not worth what i predict would be $10-$20 a month. No way.

Yeah so I decided to try the game after watching it in ads and the mini games caught my attention. I thought that I would play the fish eating the other fish and defeating the bigger ones, and so forth... But after I downloaded it and started to play it, I found out that I don't get to play hardly any mini games. Instead, like all these other games (Royal Match, Gardenscapes, and so forth), I mostly get those puzzles, where I have to match things. It's just as lame as the other games!

This game is pretty one dimensional. The main game to get coins for new fish for the aquarium is LAME!. I hate it and would probably uninstall if not for my 2yr old son that likes watching the fish swim around. Also, it's false advertising since the mini games you see on the ads are NOTHING like the actual game experience. If you like games that are repetitive in nature, then you might like this, but it's not for me. Planet fish was the best phone fish game imo. Wish it would come back.

I like the game. It's fun. I'm just sick of the pay to play/win game structure. Make a game skill based and charge for the game. I'd be more than happy to pay for it. All this "buying lives" to play and buying power ups to help clear levels and compete against other players is old and I just won't play a game like that. So I will be uninstalling this. Graphics are clean, controls are simple, Game play you get 5 "lives" to clear a board. after that you have to by more or wait for a timer to play.

I have played this game for years. Very disappointed and pretty much over it. With each update, comes more glitches. Matches don't create the bonuses accurately. I don't mind spending a little $ to play a game I enjoy. But this has just become a drain. Lessen the number of days of the gold pass. I used to get it, when it was for 30 days. Now everytime it is a different duration. I am on the hunt for something else, because this just isn't it anymore with all the glitches that work in their favor

I am beyond disappointed. The advertisement is a blatant lie. I wanted to save the little fish but no. It's some match 3 game like Gardenscape or Homescape (also made by this developer). I should have known. They use false & deceptive advertising for all the other games of theirs that I've tried. I did give the game a shot. It's boring and once you get into higher levels, it becomes impossible without putting money in or tons of lives per level. I do not recommend & I am uninstalling.

I loved the old fishdom graphics. When you did the last update it changed the look of the game pieces, ie; the G, pearls, sea shells ect. Why change something that is working? If it's not broken, don't fix it. We got used to the graphics/game pieces, have looked like, for years now. It's hard to play with the game peices looking way fake & hard to look at. I really hope you can change it back. I tried to play and I just can't. Fishdom was a favorite game of mine. I used to play everyday.

I've been playing Fishdom for years now, probably since it's creation. I loved it! I, along with many other long time players, are now seriously thinking of deleting it and finding another game to play. Fishdom developers have been changing everything players loved about the game. It is no longer fun and exciting. They have made the levels too difficult to beat without multiple boosters and then made it harder to earn boosters. The only real option now, if you want to win, is to purchase them.

It's pretty fun but it can be tough, and takes away from the enjoyment getting repeatedly beaten when your lives are low. It takes forever to get more lives, and of course there's the ever present options (pressure) to purchase things. I'm less likely to pay if I feel like the game is being unfair. At times I swipe things one way and they go the other way, costing me a move. Decorating the tanks is fun but tedious due to slow earning.

I gave 2 stars because I love this game with so much of my being, but I also hate it. I love it because of the little praises the fish give, I enjoy the decorating, and the few mini games I've actually seen I like. However I hate that levels (level 508) give only 10-12 moves. And they only give you 5 lives! There's almost no way of being able to win most levels unless you get lucky or have bombs. And there is almost no mini games! This game is just plain annoying now and I'm about to uninstall.

Fun game. Not quite the game like the ads on FB though. It is pay for play, so I'm getting ready to uninstall. It doesn't give freebies to play. Would be nice if the items you place in the tanks gave some tokens along the way. Also, an occasional mini game during the wait would be ok. Entire game locks you out if you do not pay. It's frustrating to wait 25 or more minutes to play. Time to look for another. Cute but too many hurry ups to wait. Made it to Level 82 in a few days...

I used to love this game, but now after I play several levels, there are no more. you get a message saying more levels coming soon and you have to play some treasure chest thing for which you get pretty much nothing! When playing the treasure chest levels, you do not get coins for left over bombs, lightning etc. and the seahorse show goes away, too. And you have to beat a specific number of levels to even get any coins etc. Unfortunately, I'm about done with fishdom!!

Nothing like the ads, you build aquariums. Seems like fun but gers boring pretty quick. I deleted the app but then saw the cool ad, where you eat smaller fish to get bigger and then eat bigger fish smaller than you. This game doesn't do that at all. So I don't know what the ad has to do with thus app at all. You simply build your aquariums, clean them, feed your fish, then come back later to maintain them.

This is a great game, but only if you spend a bunch of money, other wise you get stuck on many levels for days. The rewards that you get are not fair either, they dont give out enough coins or power ups for beating the harder levels. When I realized how much I had spent on buying items to get out of the level that I had been stuck at for days, I was blown away... This game is a trap to get your money.!

Editing my review from 3 years ago. I originally gave 5 stars now it just sucks. It's definitely a P2P game now. I'm past level 3000 and if I spend money my levels will be "super hard, challenge, hard, regular, super hard" just so that I have to use what I just bought. Then you'll be stuck on a "normal" level for 24 hours after your bonuses are gone. If you buy the bi weekly bonuses you'll have to spend even more money to beat the levels to get the chest at the end. I used to love this game 😔

Too expensive! Some levels are extremely difficult. And before you know it, you're making in app purchases. Not getting a lot back for your money and you spent a fortune. It's a fun game but it will trap you in to spend money. What they need to do is give a little bit more chances in the hard, difficult levels. How are you supposed to eliminate 75 pieces that need to be blown up with only fifteen turns! BS UNINSTALLED!

False advertising. they show a puzzle game which is nowhere in the game. I read the comments after to see what was going on, and this problem has been brought up several times, which they said they would bring up to the development team, but they still haven't fixed it. Super unethical, so I'd recommend not downloading it. They need to either include puzzle levels or take the advertisement down, instead if just commenting like oh, yeah, we'll take care of it

This game is super fun, but I will reiterate the two main points that the other reviewers have stated. One, it is a total money grab. It is very difficult to get through some levels without making a purchase. (Developers, just because you keep saying that it's designed to be played without purchasing doesn't make it so. Perhaps you should listen to your users). Two, I am well past level 700 and have yet to see the minigame with the big crowd of fish that you have to eat your way through.

This is game is horrible. It's not even as advertised and what I wanted to play in the first place. There's no eating other fish. It's not even fun. It's infuriating if anything. Levels can be hard but not straight up impossible. I spent an hour trying to beat one singular level and used all the powerups in existence yet still it was unbeatable. Why do I need powerups every single level?? This game just wasted my time. Uninstalling without the slightest bit of a doubt.

Fisdom ad is false advertising. The ads shown are one of the mini games. Every time I see the ad, I'm disappointed it's not the real game. I got to level 17, and the mini game, which is advertised, is no longer popping up. It is a different mini-game. To the app developer, the actual game is great. It is a good puzzle, so why not promote the actual game. I recommend that instead of the mini game, create the actual game that lured people here.

So, I seen the ad for this game and it looked like fun. Then, I played it. It is nothing like the ad for it. It is Bejeweled but with shells. After going through a few games and not even seeing what was advertised and shown as you strategically going after bigger fish and eating them thus creating your fish to get bigger. Simple right. Not even close. I uninstalled it. You are not even given a decent amount of time to play the game before it cuts you off for you to begin again. Sucks

Downloaded this thinking I would get to play games that would "save the fish" from different dangers. Instead, I got an aquarium and a bunch of different kinds of games that are really difficult to play without purchasing "diamonds" or other packages of "helps". I will go back to Panda Pop. I feel like this isn't what it was advertised to be.

Sometimes it's kind of fun... but its rigged to get you to spend money. So it's way more frustrating than it is entertaining. It's also very deceiving because it's not at all like the ads. It's a match 3 game, not the fish eating other fish like they portray it. There are a few little mini games that are like that, but they're short & dumb & there's only a few in between boards for a short period of time. None of the side quests are very rewarding. It's just irritating bc they're so greedy.

I like the graphics of this game but there is too much going on. Sometimes less is more. I also didn't like it when I was forced to choose a specialty fish and then had to pay game money to store the fish. I was attracted to the game to build and decorate my own aquarium. I almost uninstalled the game, and am waiting to see if more shenanigans happen. Otherwise, it is enjoyable and very visually pleasing.

I like this game. It's basically watching Nemo from the Disney movie go through pipes and waterways as you unlock games and slide barriers around to help him move along. It's fun, it's easy, it's NOT REALLY the game. That was the game I wanted to play. Not this Candy Crush create an aquarium game? Where's the game from the ad? That's the one I want. This whole switcheroo has me so disappointed. While the actual game is more fun and appealing than most of the Candy Crush derivatives, the objective to create an aquarium with animated fish is boring as hell. Dudes, way to make a game boring. Get back to me when you create the exciting and more challenging game from the ads!!!

Like everyone else says.. It's completely different from the ad. What a stupid company... They made the game in the ad look clever and interesting, and then the real game just rips off typical gem matching games. They spent the time to brainstorm and come up with a good idea, and then use it to scam people instead of just make the game. Very weird. I understand they will be adding mini games soon which are closer to the advertisements. That's a good first step, but put out an apology

Money Pit. I really enjoyed playing the game but, as the levels become more difficult, it quickly requires you to use any buffs you have and eats up your lives. Even though I began the game with the intent to spend little if any money, it was requiring (or enticing) me to spend $3 a day, regularly. I uninstalled it, and started to play Candy Crush Saga, which thus far (level 18, game 218) is much better. It is a similar game format (minus the decor creativity), but much less money.

I've been playing Fishdom on another device and used to enjoy the game. Not anymore. Over the last few months it has become all about getting the player to spend more in in-app purchases. I was happy enough to part with a few $ while the game was fun but they are taking moves away plus some other changes... they've wrecked the game. They clearly don't value their customer base. Do not recommend.

Been playing for awhile. Had to start over, Because of getting a new phone. I Didn't save my progress. Know I'm all caught up and almost finished with the game!! Great game for when I'm relaxed after work. Well know that I'm at Level 500 are so the game want's me to update. The problem is it's slow and I can't update at all. How can y'all fix this problem. # Stuck in limbo!!

BE AWARE!! I played this game for a couple of days but then I made 1 small purchase. This is my experience. They will charge you multiple times for 1 purchase. The app will tell you that purchase was unsuccessful and you don't get any items you try to pirchase on the game but they still charge you and make it extremely difficult for you to get your money back. The game is designed to get you to make a purchase. HORRIBLE PEROPLE WHO MADE THIS GAME. THEIVES!!!!

It's cute and I really liked it until this "limited time" stuff. I worked really hard to unlock the camping fish and can't buy them because the event ended and I'm just a few coins short. People have lives. Games shouldn't make you worship them to be able to unlock cool stuff. The ads are also extremely misleading. Nothing like the actual game. Playrix does this with all of their games. STOP ADVERTISING GAMES THAT DON'T EXIST. Not going to play any of their games until they fix these issues!

I gave it two stars because I do like the playing the game. There are a frustratingly annoying things that need to be changed. 1. Gems are stupid hard to get and everything is expensive. 49 Gems for 3 rockets but it takes 30 hours of play time to collect 9 gems. 2. If I have to put in the work to fill the piggy bank I shouldn't have to pay for those gems. I earned them. 3. Chill on the amount of pop ups in a row. Up to 6 or 7 is ridiculous! 4. Needing to beat levels to unlock holiday items now has to go. I'm on level 1080. Beating 126 levels in less than 14 days to unlock the holiday fish at this point is unattainable. Just beginning the game 126 would be no problem. If these areas were to improve, I would change my review.

Was fun for the 3 or 4 days I was able to play before it started crashing. I don't have time for that nonsense. Update: So a year later after the first negative experience, they seem to have fixed the crashing, but now it's a money drain . . . Or trying to be. I simply will NOT pay to play a "free" game. No matter how impossible you make levels to pass. And there's no rhyme or reason. They're just rolling along and suddenly impossible and you can sit there for DAYS unless you buy the helps.

It started out as a fun game, not happy that you complete games, and when you fill the whale with diamonds, you have to pay to have them, or after you have achieved your awards to be able to continue, when you failed a level, they will steal them from you. On top of that, I downloaded the game because it initially seemed to be a different game; where a small fish gradually grows eating bigger fish, but in the end, here you are clearing out tiles after tiles.

Another game that requires you to pay to play. If you do pay, it then expects you to keep paying to move forward in the levels. I have have paid my fair share. And I'm done. No gratitude for paying players. If you stop spending money, you will be stuck for days and days. I've seen the pattern of how it sets up the level for you to win or fail. So, yes the levels may be beatable to win without paying, but you will have to play for several days Another game that will scam you for money.

I only played for a few minutes because of the obnoxious hints given in the game. I want a game that I can sit back, relax, and figure out how to beat the levels on my own. Stop giving hints when the players hesitates for a measly 1.5 seconds. Give us a way to turn off the hints completely. I have deleted other games for this exact reason. Until the option of "turn off hints" is given to the players, I will not play.

The ad that is shown is for a mini game inside the actual game. The actual game is a character game with little minigames to win coins. It's perfectly fine if you like games that are storytelling and character building, and you fiddle around with a character. I do not. The ad needs to be change because it's false advertising. Marketing team is hot trash or this company is sketck as hell to run that ad. Downloaded and deleted in under 5 mins.

If I could, I would've given negative stars! I've been playing thus game for over 4 years. It's always been great fun. They offer gold passes that earns you lots of boosters, diamonds, time ect. It's usually about a 1 month pass for 4.99. Like everyone else, they've gotten greedy. Now the gold passes dont give near what they did. Also it's only about 6 days now for 4.99. Several people have already left. Our whole team is looking for a better game to join.

Fun, when it doesn't lock up, but expensive. Past level 1000 you'll need to spend money to make the game playable, and it gets expensive very quickly. And it locks up, losing your power-ups, with no way to reset it or replay the level without being heavily penalized. I'm uninstalling it for these reasons. When they get better programmers, I might consider playing it again.

This game makes the levels extremely difficult to force you to buy gems and lightning. Customer support is horrible. I had an issue with purchases and received error messages. My account was charged, yet I did not get my items. Customer service was not helpful in getting the matter resolved. I provided ample proof and did not receive the email receipt of the purchases. I have deleted the app. Do not recommend this game. Don't waste time and money!

Use to love this game! There is a golden ticket purchase with extras that use to last 32 days, then only 27 days, and now its every 6 days before you spend $$$. The number of days changed, the way you earn extras changed but the price stayed the same. Its nothing but a money grab and very disappointing. My team is the only reason I dont uninstall the game but I'm not sure how much longer that will keep me. They are all just as upset. I changed my rating from 5 to 1

I give up. A fun game but the amount of money I have to drop into the game to advance, not fun anymore. From now on, I will play for free and when I get bogged down, will delete and start over on my game tablet. This is supposed to be fun and it's not anymore. Deleted on my phone. Edited to add...after reading reviews, two stars might be too generous. No matter, no more money from me. Edited to add again...Yeah, the levels may be beatable but only after youve gone broke paying for help.

This game is misleading. The commercials show something completely different. The reason I DL it. It's another candy crush game. However, it's rigged to use all 5 of your hearts to pass one board, if you do pass. It's not worth the money, frustration and time spent on this game. Also, if you get unlimited hearts, you must use them at that time, which cannot be saved. This makes it difficult to play during your break from work or school. Positive note, the fish are very cute!

This game is not visually impaired friendly. None of the text works with select to speak. The conversations that the fish pop up and go away too fast to be easily read with magnification. Also, I don't like being told that I can claim a reward, only to be asked to buy it. Was advertised as something that it's mostly not. I only wanted to play the game that is actually a mini game that it will only occasionally allow you to play. This is mainly a candy crush like game mixed in with some others.

The game is nothing like the ads. Don't hit me with "As of now, there is no such feature within the game..." Because there'll probably never be the same gameplay that is shown in the ads. Y'all just needed a way to make your game stand out compared to the 100s of others that are the same. I'm just here to let people know how ridiculous you are for having an ad for a baked potato when you're really just selling fries: both are fine, but they're different and 1 you can get just about anywhere.

Yet another game that the only way to get very far on it is to keep spending real money to buy perks. There is supposedly 1500 levels to this game, so, at roughly $3 per $100 levels, that works out to around $50 to finish the game. I have been at level 67 for 3 days, and there is no way to advance until I buy "perks", like bombs, to clear levels with.

It's an OK game but it's not what is advertised. I wanted to play the game in the ads, where you eat a bunch of 5 point fish until you're high enough level to eat 100 point fish, then 250, etc etc. That literally isn't a thing in this game. It's a fish tank that you decorate, and you earn money to decorate by playing a matching game (like candy crush or royal match). It's fine, and maybe even fun, and if they portrayed THAT GAME in the ads I'd probably give it 5 stars.

This is NOT the game that was demoed! This is a timed match game not the puzzle game demoed. This game is geared to get your money. NOT HAPPY! Controls on my tablet were glitchy & delayed moves which used time. I spent more than 30 minutes on the FIRST match game in the first level & every loss I was "offered opportunity" to buy power ups so I could win the level. It's been on my tablet 30 minutes & that's 30 minutes too long! Great graphics are about the only good I can say about it.

It's a fun game that is ruined by greed. There's more ways to spend money than ways to play. Many levels are designed to be tight (even with items) so you'll frequently be stuck retrying the same level a few times. In a normal game it'd be fine, but this one specifically limits lives and locks you to retrying the same level until you beat it or give up after 3 days and spend money. Infinite lives tend to be given out at unfortunate times, and you'll usually end up wasting them.

I have played several of this companies games, and while the potential for fun is there, the greed that this company has... making it impossible to pass levels unless you spend real money for powerups, seems downright criminal. I've reached a point where all of my 'diamonds' are being banked and they want $3 to release them. I can't get past the level I'm on because the goal is to remove 154 blocks in 1min 30 seconds, AND I have to wait 2 1/2 hours to get lives back ( or buy them)! DELETED!!!

Deceitful and expensive Even if the graphics are nice, it is just another version of candy crush, exactly the same, nothing original. They advertise the mini puzzles but you don't get to play any of those at all. I completed almost 50 levels and did not see a puzzle. I contacted them and they responded I hadn't been lucky and to keep playing. The diamonds you get from your own victories, go to a piggy bank that you have to buy later with your real money if you want to use them. GREEDY.

I saw this game advertised on another game I play. Once I downloaded and began to play it, it wasn't the same game advertised. This game is your typical match three or four items in a row puzzle, which is okay, but I tried several games like this already. The way this game is advertise is you start off as a little fish eating other little fishes, getting powerups to advance to other stages or your fish gets eaten. However, that's not what I gotten, which is pretty misleading.

Honestly? Really disappointed. Downloaded the game based on an ad i saw and the game was nothing like the ad showed. The part showed in the ad was a mini game that i only got to see every ten levels or so if not less. It was still a fun game but nothing what i expected and certainly not something I'll play more than a day or so. And i downloaded it from the link from the ad so i know i didn't get the game wrong. It's just not what was advertised.

Kinda fun at first, but start getting into the 500's and good luck. I'm in the 600's and am literally stuck. So far, 40+ lives attempted and still have not passed it. Some levels are even worse, and they aren't even labeled hard or very hard. A great game if you have a ton of gems and power ups, or if you're not planning on spending money to pass levels, and consequently don't mind being in the lowest tiers for tournaments, then play this. If not, then pass it up.

I really did enjoy playing Fishdom but now its become more frustrating to me than enjoyable; due to being forced to search for treasure every single day, week after week! It has wasted my time/money to even play now that I cannot reap the same rewards as lower level players. Im unable to purchase any new items for my current fish tank which is the ONLY way to progress in the game! Therefore I cannot level up and/or progress any further even though there are newer levels above me being advertised!

This game is for children, I dont mean that as an insult, I got to level 12 or so, the game is just so childish, but I had seen ads for it everywhere, no ads in game is really cool, and if you've got like a 5 year old, I'm sure they'll like it a lot. 2 stars cause I'm tired of seeing ads for it, and I was trying to play that mini game in the first picture they show where you're surrounded by fish, but I didnt see it anywhere and I'm not putting anymore time into doing so lol

Not the game they promised. The game shown was you facing different obstacles to help your fish through a path. This game is just like candy crush. It does have cute fish tanks you build, but it's difficult to send/receive lives and impossible to work as a team, even though they push it on you. This is from the same people with Gardenscapes, which is also not the game they advertised it to be. Just make the games we want. Quit the bait and switch!

I NEVER download games, but I was so excited to help the cute little fish get out of trouble. Based on the misleading ad, that's what I thought I would be doing. If I wanted to play a matching-crush game, I would've downloaded Candy Crush. I deleted the Fishdom app immediately after I couldn't get past level 2 without making a purchase. This game sucks!

I notice they post all the 5 star reviews first, but here's my 1 star review anyway. I liked this game at first, but they constantly push you to buy! Buy decorations, buy more lives, buy tools to help you win. And if you don't, you have to wait 20, 25, 27 minutes for another chance to play? No thanks I'm not that desperate to pay money to play this "free" game. They also like to leave you stuck on a level for days.

The advertisements are super deceptive. Scratch that, they just straight up lie in the ads. This is just a run of the mill match game, and you have to go as far as reading the description to find that out. From the ads, to the icon, to the images provided. All fabricated. Don't support this app or company, no matter how much you might want to play. These games are a dime a dozen.

I loved playing this game. That was until they started making you purchase more moves when you still have 15+ moves available to make. It won't let you do anything but forfeit the game unless you make a purchase, but you still have moves that won't cost you any money that you CAN make, as indicated in your available moves indicator. If I could add a picture, I would. I do have many screenshots.

I am a long time player. I understand price increase. but you also cut boosters. I get more of the hard levels than regular. a lot of the regular levels are multi. I miss the seasonal aquariums and the rooms. the Expeditions are just repeat. this latest update third time y'all have cut boosters. it is obvious that all y'all are interested in is making money. as for the mini games I have yet to come across one. I'm a level nine.

For starters, if you've found this game via the "logic puzzle levels" ad, don't even bother downloading. While the game is a fun match-3,4,5,6 and so on, it isn't at all what the ad depicted or even lead me to believe. That is false advertising and is a felony. I don't know who came up with your ads playtrix, but I recommend you either adjust them or take them down and start fresh.

This game is an absolute cash grab. No ads, but ive gotten to level 93 and hit a wall. They dont give you enough moves to switch the pieces around unless you use a power up. The power ups cost gems, the gems cost real money. Basically, you have to pay money to advance in the game and get far. i dont normally leave reviews, but i was honestly enjoying the game until this and felt it necessary to help others avoid what i went through. There are other flaws in the game, but this was #1. Uninstalled

It's just another candy crush game by another name. Also it only runs in wide screen not phone screen, in 1 hand. My biggest complaint overall is how it's advertised as a math strategy game and it turns out that this part of the game is just a little mini game you have to play "candy crush" for hours to earn. After several levels it never comes back. I consider that both bait and switch and false advertising. At the end of the day, just download candy crush, if that's what you want to play.

Very Misleading. This game is nothing like advertised. This is another matching game. As you go up to the level, this game is programed to buy extra items in order to move up to the next level or finish the hard level. I have a very stressful job and I started to play this game to relieve my stress and I ended up getting more stressed. LOL. I uninstalled it today.

I was enjoying this game for a while...I got to level 33 and I have been stuck. I even paid to get more diamonds to continue playing after my 30 moves were used and I still couldn't beat it. I've used all my extra helpers like the explosives and the lightning and it didn't make a difference. I tried it when I had an hour of unlimited lives and still couldn't get it. I want to keep playing and enjoying this game, but if I can't get passed this level there is no use keeping it:(

So disappointing! Why couldn't they make the actual game they showed in the advertisement? I didn't want a stupid match 3 game, I wanted the action puzzles as shown! I played on thinking I could "earn" a chance to play a puzzel, but NO. Plus if you want to beat some of the levels ,you have to spend $, Otherwise you run out of moves before completing the tasks.If it actually obeys your commands, and you use extra ammo, you may proceed . I feel I was generous rating it a ☆☆. Deception and greed!

I was a little bit leary of downloading this game at first. I was assuming it would be similar to other games of its like! They give you at first a tease of the game and then you have to fork out a grip load of money to progress to higher levels or to obtain special decorations! However I was plesantly surprised that this was NOT the case with Fishdom! I haven't spent a single penny on the game and I am currently on the 500 levels of the game that has, I believe, 2,000 plus levels! Worth it!!

1st... the game is fun, and, unfortunately, addicting. I say unfortunately because it is very hard to actually progress if you don't spend a bunch of your hard-earned real life cash money. I always say I won't spend any but you HAVE to if you want to gain levels. Most of the diamonds you earn by beating levels go into a "piggy bank" and you have to pay real money to access them. I understand in-app purchases, but we are forced to pay to progress. It is the same way in other Playrix games, too.

Did not like it. Also the ads for this game are annoying, making it seem like a different game, but just a matching game where they manipulate the difficulty curve to convince players to spend money. The have is at first easy, then challenging, until the momentum slows to a halt and a player must make purchases to continue. You may as well get the hacked version if the source is GPL.

Saw an ad for this game. Thought the fish eating other fish minigame looked fun. The ad made it seem like that was the main feature of the game, but you barely ever get to play that type of minigame. I don't understand why make an ad like that if it's not even that relevant to the game. If you came up with a minigame idea you think people will really want to play, enough to where you make an ad for your game based entirely around that minigame, then why not make that minigame freely accessible?

It's a brainless, but fun, time-waster. As with most games like this, they will lure you with lots of rewards and extras to get you to play. After awhile they'll make it impossible to pass a level and prompt you to buy something extra. I usually just stop playing at that point. After awhile, they'll send you free rewards to get you to keep playing. At that point, I continue playing. Honestly, this game is nice but it's NOWHERE near good enough to spend money on.

FUN BUT MISLEADING! People, this is a candy crush style game. I'm on level 70 and so far I've played the "fish eating fish" game exactly once. If candy crush matching games are your thing then you might like it, but if you want to play because of the fish hunting game, don't bother downloading. On the plus side, its not riddled with ads like some games so there's that.

Fun, addicting actually, with a lot of variety, and increasingly challenging puzzles, but I really dislike that gems earned must be purchased for use with cash, as well as chances to play the games. I also dislike that there are requirements to purchase further game time, or that a timed break is mandatory. Just let us play and use our earned gems and other items

Update: I've been playing this game for years and I adore almost everything this game offers. More recently I've felt that the mini games have been a let down. I'm tired of the explorer trails being so repetitive. They used to offer a much wider selection of mini games: the submarine and the ladder game were my favourites! Now I find I'm bored of the same thing. The main game itself is still brilliant, but I used to enjoy the variety of side games too. Please bring those back!

This game is very frustrating the programing is set up to get money out of you. I have noticed several things , Firstly I will be on a roll with free time or bonuses, if I get a phone call or text I need to take, when I go back to game I've been stripped of all the bonuses I gained. also if I use a triangle bonus it will usually take the color that us most needed. but if you are on a hard level never will it take the color that will win the level. this had happened again and again.

honestly a pretty good game. basic but pretty good. I downloaded it to earn premium currency for another game and so far this is the only game I've actually completed all the offers for. there's no ads at all, the gameplay is just basic matching (the puzzle levels end after like 100 levels thankfully bc I don't like them) there were definitely some tricky levels but there's a lot of power ups/endless lives that help you make fast progress.

None of the ads I've seen display that it's yet another matching game. It's not a bad matching game, but there are unfortunately other games that offer the same gameplay only better. The power ups are pretty weak and the best one ,2 lightings, is completely random so you can't even strategize where they appear.The advertisements show a numbers game that appears occasionally as a mini game, on a much simpler scale. -2 stars for misleading ads and underwhelming gameplay, +1 star for having no ads.

Be aware on level 1233 it's a challenge level the game will freeze and you will not be able to back out of the game without losing all of your power ups and a life I just experienced this and tried talking to customer service if you call that customer service. And they've done nothing to restore it. Even though it's the games fault.

Wish you can save your unlimited lives/time Stop with the mini adventure game and bring back the mini matching game!!!!!! I want the mini merge game back!!! *update. Please bring back the mini merge game. Love this game. *upset about the update not having the mini matching game, and having the journey game instead. That one isn't enjoyable, and I don't understand why it's the mini game again when you usually go back and forth between the two.

Once a good game. My partner introduced it to me. She's been playing it for years. in the time I've been playing it's gone from a fun game with some challenge to a frustrating hard game with levels that you are stuck on for days unless you pay for extras. Now they have removed the team chat, taking the social aspect from it. Any communication with the dev goes through an AI chat it and goes nowhere. Save your sanity and skip.

Removed ability for UK players to use chat feature. How am I supposed to communicate with my team. played this game for many years, lately it's become more of a 'pay to win' game. Too many side games/quests. As if the increased team numbers wasn't bad enough to start with. Looks like I'll be no longer playing. What a disappointment. 5stars down to one star from me! My old review from 7yrs ago... Very addictive game. lots of fun creating aquariums as well as doing the matching game too.

the latest update means I can't chat to my team (What's the point of being in a team then?), the adventure game doesn't allow me to click the blue bottles or the coin bags, or click on treasure gates to find the key. the animation is so slow there's no point playing a race game anymore and when I'm out of moves, the animation is overly large, annoying and slow. I've been toying with uninstalling for a while and this might just have made the decision for me.

The game forced me to update right in the middle of playing and there was no option to postpone it. I had active boosters and unlimited lives running, but while the game was updating, all of that bonus time expired. I lost my rewards for no reason. Please don't force updates during gameplay, or at least pause active timers until the update is complete. It was really annoying

I like the game ,however when there is a new update ,cards you have collected before the updates, it all vanishes and one has to start all over again and then to buy coins , it's quite pricey , thinking of the cost of leaving from where I come from , not the best.. so for the updates. please consider all the levels and gift cards acquired .

I love playing Fishdom because it is fun, relaxing, and entertaining. The graphics and puzzles are enjoyable, and I like decorating the aquariums. However, the game requires updates too often, sometimes every few days or every month. These updates use a lot of internet data and storage space, and sometimes the game does not work properly without updating.
