I now have to be wary of every game that has character level-up minigames and in-app purchases now. The minigames, while OK, are short, rare and hidden behind match-3 puzzles, terrariums, microtransactions and VIP reward paths. And like every in-game currency app, the game constantly reminds you of your familiars (fish), and throws "bundles" and "competitions" at you every 3-5mins. I've yet to meet a game that only gives you just 1 thing to focus on, that isn't a purchase.

I want to have a choice in whether I have an update or not, you force them to stop the game and sometimes I don't have the speed to download fast as I'm on Data not WiFi. It's just annoying to wait 20 minutes to play while it's updating. I have to edit this review I thought it had loaded, it didn't, I uninstalled to see if loading that way may be faster no! It is forever stuck on Pending 😣. I can reload Fishdom.

A money grab. Too few moves to complete levels, way too stingey with gems, lives take too long to refill....I could go on and on with how frustrating this game is. I wish I had never started and never gave them any of my money. Games do not get easier when stuck on a level. I have been stuck for days on a single level. And their help desk does not answer your questions if it is not specific. Other people on YouTube show way more lives then anything I've ever gotten. Time for a new game

My review today is not about the game in general.. the game is great. I really do not like the recent upgrade for the Gold pass.. I feel like we are getting ripped off. I'm paying the same money for less options and only if I pass a level. Most of the time I try to beat the challenges for coins to open the chest. It's the only way I can pass some of the levels

Played a demo in an ad, and it had a genuinely innovative game mechanic involving levelling up a fish by consuming others that was quite fun, so I downloaded. Only to discover that that isn't the game at all - this is a generic match 3 with a build-an-aquarium concept stapled on. If you have so little faith in your own game that you have to advertise it as something completely different to get me to download it, why should I bother playing it?

Typical "candy crush" type of game. Started off fun. I was looking forward to the mini games, but they are missing in action. The mini games are the reason I installed the game on my device. Furthermore, I refuse to spend real money for fake money or to beat levels. Don't think I will keep the game. But, on the other hand, it kills time, the idea of building the aquariums to your liking is kinds neat

I love this game but like all the other players raising the cost of playing, the level of difficulty, the length of time to complete a level, how quickly the gold pass game ends and the rising costs I am so unhappy, even frustrated with playing the game. Sometimes when you're on a difficult level, which is almost all of them, you can see the coloured balls etc fall as if it's rigged. Your response is to contact support inside the app, that does ZERO. They say they'll send to the developers. Done

When I tried to play today, it said to update the game now and recieve a gift. So I updated it. When update was finished I tried to play again.. it still says: update and recieve a gift. And this message wont disappear. Thanks for the gift, being such a waste of my time. Mini games come almost never and they were the reason for me downloading the game in the first place. I agree with others who say that the decorations and fishes are way too expensive, progress is slow and you get stuck for days

I agree with what the others have been saying. This game has become a buy diamonds or can't pass levels game. Boring!!! This no longer makes the game free to play. If you don't change this soon, I am deleting the game and moving on. I refuse to have to spend money every second level to pass it, since there are so few moves that it is impossible to pass without using extra bombs etc. Listen to what we are trying to tell you.

I used to enjoy the game a lot, then it seemed you had to spend more and more, or you got stuck at a level. Jokes is I had to change my review because I recently stopped playing because I was spending too much on BS. Always having to pay for something you have already earned, ie the "fishy bank" I wish I could get half the money I spent back and I wouldn't think this and other similar games are such a waste of time and money. Do yourself a favour, stop playing this game and others like it.

One of the best games ever. Would have been the number one if the following is added 1. If one is able to pause and continue later 2. If one can carry forward his/her moves. Eg. If I'm given 10 moves to complete a task, but I used only 5, the rest five should be reserved so that when I'm out of moves in the future, I can fall on them. With these in place, no game can beat this. If you're downloading this game, please make it a point to join team "winners" where champions are.

Addicted - I love the graphics, game play, and events. currently, the only issue that irritates me is the unlimited lives. I just got a surprise 1 hour and then a 2 hour. this would be great if I wasn't headed to bed. I wish there was a way I could bank these to a limited amount and use them when I can, for instance on my lunch break or when I have time to waste. really want to stay up for 3 hours and play but work comes first. please consider a banked option for unlimited lives.

The game only alternates between Hard and Super Hard and if you are unlucky, the next level will be the same as the hard one but it wont indicate if it will be hard or moderate. So in short this game gives you stress after stress, you can never relax with this. But the challenge levels are fun coz they usually have more than 25 moves to buy you some time. In conclusions, download it if you are not short tempered like me coz if you are then you will break your phone.

A nightmare to make purchases through. I have tried to buy numerous deals and offers, but every time I go to make the purchase, the game pulls up the wrong Google play account, no matter how many times I disconnect and connect to the correct one. I've tried numerous ways to fix this and all failed. I've tried contacting them to figure out what's going on so I can actually buy but it's been crickets. Never thought I'd have to chase down a company to take my money. Guess I'll keep it.

Stop advertising false games!!! This is NOT the puzzle game advertised! I don't understand how you can get away with such misleading ads that do not at all represent the actual ad. I wish there was a way this could be reported and removed! The funny thing is, I actually want to play the advertised puzzle game. Why can't you focus your energy on creating the actual game you're advertising, instead of so much deception!?

I clicked on an ad that was actually fun, where you got the fish to swim in a circle to eat a bunch of things and then get bigger. But after installing, it only teases you with a few mini games like that and it's just a standard tile game. Like, the ad had sharks, whales, thalassaphobia vibes. I just wanted to play the satisfying, well-designed game in the ad. Just show that it's mainly a tile game with a cute aquarium setting. That's what my two stars are for.

It was fun in the beginning...but one of the latest updates made the game hard and exhausting to play. They have changed the power ups and rewards system, some of the "easy" levels are hard to pass... In order to un-stuck urself you have to pay money for the progress in the game. I'm quite tired of it to be honest. 27.7.25 It became even worse than my previous review. If I could I would give 0 stars. I'm uninstalling the game. Fair well and thank you for the fish 🐟

After playing the "Playable Ad" a few times, I decided to download it. I was disappointed to discover that it was nothing like the advertisements but was little more than another Candy Crush type game. If the ad had more accurately depicted the game, I could have made a more informed choice. On the other hand, why couldn't the game have been more like the ads? It would have been a far better, more engaging and original game if it had. If you can't manage that then at least advertise HONESTLY.

The game used to be very good. Even I have spent some money on it. However, now it gets bored. Always same missions, for many months we don't have the special levels. Also they did dramatic changes harming the players. The dynamite and lightning are not together, we used to got 2 bombs and we used that help and now just 1 is provided, no time with unlimited lives (except you pay), no more 3+ moves after you pass e levels in a row and the increased the prices. so bad. I was a 15K level player

These levels are impossible to win. Your system is designed to force ppl to buy lives and gems to pass the levels. So redicule. I will leave a one star review and uninstall this app. There are plenty of other games to play. Very disappointed, the levels are getting impossible to beat. Not enjoying the game anymore! It's supposed to be fun to play. Fix the issue or you'll loose players!

Free to download, but now expensive to play! Was enjoyable, but recent changes are very unfair. Some players get bonus passes, others don't. If you want to purchase the bonus pass, they now only last less than 7 days, rather than 3 or 4 weeks, but still cost £4.99. I'm in an amazing team, that are all now feeling the same way. Unless Fishdom reverts then I would not recommend playing this game and I suspect the company will be loosing a lot of players/revenue.

Having fun so far! Really love this game. The graphics are beautiful. I would like a list of purchases I've made though. Also I really really dislike timed games. I play it to relax! Give k diamonds from piggy bank once and a while. The tanks are fun to rearrange. The fun fish are really expensive too. Takes a long time to collect the vouchers. All and all fantastic little game. I even enjoy the music which I turn down on most games. I haven't spent a cent. Watch videos for diamonds and slowly collect boosters. I just lowered my rating in an edit. You asked for a review right when I got a stupid timed level. CUT IT OUT!!! Not fun not relaxing. No extra anything! What's your point? Use up my lives fast?

I wanna eat fish, not play match-3. The fact you cannot choose minigames and you are forced to play random, boring, easy ones is no fun. Also, the advertisement is misleading, you eat like 3 fish, not that many. I don't understand why there's no laws to prevent fake advertising, as this seems to be a trend. Anyway, don't expect much, and certainly not what was advertised. I spent more time writing this review than I played the game, that should tell you!

When I installed the game it was different than it was shown on the app detail pictures... It shows a fish in a pipe etc. I got to level 406 and that never happened, you match 3-6 in a row and unlock aquariums and decorate them to urn beauty stars. But if you got the game like me and thought you would be solving puzzly things that's not at all what this app is about. You can join a team and interact with team. On the upper hand it is very social in an anti- social way. If that's your jam get it!

Update: after reading other reviews it seems others were mislead by the ads too. Is that to get more downloads?? I'll be uninstalling. Confused as game is different to ads. The ads show saving the fish using strategic moves that hold back lava or sharks etc, and getting the fish out safely. I've played to level 29 so far of fishdom and that hasn't been in one level. Does it come later?

Updates are supposed to make the game more fun, but they’re making it really boring. The bomb along with the triangle has disappeared, and I think that’s a big downside. The 15–30 minute rewards are gone too. And we don’t want any more mini-games with map exploration either.The "Double Bomb" booster has been reduced from two bombs to just one bomb. WHY?? It’s really annoying.😒

Misleading advertising. The Fishdom ad I saw looks like a "Piranha" type game where the fish eat small fishes to grow big enough to eat bigger fishes, but that was just the mini-game.. They pushed the mini game in their ads like it's the primary game structure; the main game is actually a match-3 "Candy Crush" type of game. I played several levels and it's all the same structure. This is not the game I expected from their ad, and it's such a shame because the graphics look amazing.

The usual money-making scheme. Lots to do in the game, but a lot of it is inaccessible unless you pay real cash. Can't even collect the diamonds you win by playing without purchasing a moneybox with real cash - that's really what broke the enjoyment for me. For those who specifically prefer to spend money on a game, this will be ideal. For the rest, the fun is stunted and it can end up being frustrating.

Free to try but Pay to Progress. Game does not play as advertised. This is mostly a bejeweled type of game with very few different puzzles here and there. Games are soon made unreasonably hard to virtually impossible to win unless one spends real money on a lot of boosters to use at once. There are better and less predatory games out there. I suggest skipping this one. PS: don't waste my time with a toxic dev response of "try a better strategy". You know what you did.

Hi! :) I just wanted to say that this game is amazing,no commercials, nothing, but what really bothers me is that you are pushing people to stop playing it. To be more precise,me. I managed to reach 8193 level without any passes, nothing, because the game was fair when it comes to rewards, then fishdom challenge that gives you 3 diamonds.... And now,you updated it,and literally every single lighting you gave is next to the colour that won't help you win!

Really aggressive "pay us! BUY!!!" advertising everywhere... With the last updates they're changing a really great game (I was playing it daily for years, but I'm losing interest) to a copy of "homescapes" or one of the other games of this company which they show you advertising for all the time. I didn't install those games because I want to play Fishdom and not those. And now they're putting those games IN Fishdom. I don't know why they want to kill this game, but the method definitely works.

What everyone else is saying! It's become far too expensive, mini games have gone, always have to buy gems to complete, something ridiculous like 10 moves on hard & super hard levels which is just stupid, and don't tell me there's no compulsion to buy because I'm way past level 7000 & have been playing for years-I'm addicted!! I have to play daily & have so far this year spent a fortune, I'm scared to even count up how much I've spent! Why don't you actually listen to your players & sort it out!

The game was advertised as an awesome action game where you swim around and eat other fish with dynamic controls and get to grow bigger as you play. Nope. It's just another candy crush clone. WE'RE SICK OF THIS! If you have the ability to come up with a game that actually looks fun and even create an interactive ad that allows you to play it, why don't you just make that game!? I'm not interested in candy crush. This kind of dishonest advertising should be illegal. It's unethical.

Firstly, false advertising, advert is nothing like the game, so that's totally pathetic. Actual game is fun but a money-grabbing disgrace. I paid the £2.99 to open the fishy bank (a good name), as the game is fun and the developers are a business. However, little did I know its £2.99 every time which is completely ridiculous. I like that the game is difficult at times and fun, but forcing you to pay for rewards earned in game? Not good.

Fun game and all. But. You enjoy the game, invest time in it. After a certain period, you are 'forced' to do micro-transactions, as you'll have a tough time advancing without them. "It would be a shame throwing away all your progress by quitting the game." Well, it is, and the developers know. But I have to pay in order to advance? I either quit, waste time of pay? They know that also. That mindset disgusts me. Therefore, 1*. Do not recommend.

False advertising!! Beware game play is NOT as advertised. I downloaded the game because it appeared as though you had to get the fish through different obstacles in like a stormwater drain. Looked like it might have been fun. NO mention in the ad that it was a match 3 game. Very deceptive indeed. EDIT 17th Dec. Thought I'd play for a while to see if you get to "help" the fish escape. Guess what level 407 an nothing. I'm going to legal counsel as they shouldn't be able to do this.

I have been playing Fishdom every day for over 18 months. Its my go to game. I love the interactive fish in the variety of themed fish worlds Ive created using the rewards from games played. I highly recommend this game. By the way. This review is an edit. I posted a review a while ago because I waz extremely unhappy that after making a purchase of game tokens, the option of gaining tokens by watching videos stopped. This has now been rectified and I am back to being a very satisfied player.

I installed this game because advert said it is a challange puzzle game, where you rescue some fish. It is nothing like that! Simple gem busting game. All levels nearly the same up to level 80 at least (I played it up to that so far, looking for those interesting levels, and didn't find them). Boring for someone older than 7. And they are nagging you all the time to spend some real money on addons.

Game is just as others described. And I honestly wouldn't mind spending money on it cuz it can be a fun game, as I like to support developers... but the levels are getting impossible without spending money. Been stuck on the same level for 2 days. If you are going to do that... at least give more options for gaining in game currency - like watching ads. I have no power ups and no way to beat this level without them. Also means I miss out on keeping snowy place cuz I cant earn gems for last task!

Best Game. Easy to play. No ads really helps. Nice characters in the fish. Play casually to while away the hours. After playing for quite some time now I have to agree with another comment I jsut read. 1: What happened to the mini games ?There aren't any now 2: I have noticed a theme , it is subtle but after playing for so long you pick these things up. Nothing is random...Everything IS engineered to encourage the user to spend money. I have fallen into this trap. Play with this in mind.

I agree with a lot of the comments here that they give you little moves for some of the levels, even the normal diffculty levels. I am really unhappy with the fact that just recently, last couple of days, they no longer have the timer to gain/collect more energy points for the adventure game. Now you have to spend money to get more energy or play games which in the long run they try to make it so you spend money on that too. It is an addictive game, but I am finding it not worth playing anymore.

I do love this game, but: You will stay stuck in places forever unless you spend money. Feels like a shake down. Certain updates change how you can play the game. Now I can't return to a game in progress without it resetting, losing power ups applied and paid for. Are the developers broke? They have to shake you down so obviously? I play this nearly exclusively, but I'll find another game to invest my time. I don't need to be robbed more than usual.

It's a nice game overall (even a little addictive, I would say...) with cute graphics that are improved with every new update. The biggest flaw I can find is that there are lots of things that have to be "purchased" with the bronze vouchers, but you can't exchange your accumulated silver and gold vouchers for bronze ones so as to buy more things, more quickly.

If the developers think that it's ok for them to advertise fake content then I think it's ok for me to delete this game 5 mins after I download it. Don't waste your time on this game. It's nothing line the ads. This is a match 3 game. The advertisements are inaccurate and there are no puzzles. I came here to look for a challenge but there's no challenges. If I could rate this game any less than 1 star I would. Thanks for nothing.

The game is ok-ish but first of all, it's nothing even close to advertising. I expected one kind of game and got absolutely different. It's like you wanted to buy apples and got cereal. Nothing really wrong with cereal but not what you wanted. And second problem: it's forcing you to "buy" something when you just want to play only. Seems like it's all about buying and advertising. Disappointed.

I feel let down. First and foremost this is not the same fish eating game I was enticed with in the ads. It is just a candy-crush like game of puzzle, of which after a few levels you can't complete, unless ofcourse you buy the ridiculously expensive diamonds. I didn't expect you to be this thirsty for money. I expected better. Really feel disappointed.

Update. The new weekly events where you just have to beat levels are boring and expensive. It's not worth buying a gold ticket for it. The older events where you have challenges were much better and you win even if you really struggle with a level. The game keeps crashing and I lose my power ups. Not worth playing while this happens. Update. I received a quick response from support. Hopefully the game stops crashing.

After playing for years, I finally got fed up with the game. They just made lots of changes to the game last week that made the game so difficult and no longer fun to play!! They made it such a way that you have to buy/use boosters and diamonds in order to win a level. The price of the season ticket (only lasts 20 days) went up 30%!! They reduced the effectiveness of the boosters you can collect! They really don't care about the players and just want to make money!!

Money grabber. y You need to pay to play,unless you have years & patience to play the game. It's fun in the beginning. They changed the game to include treasure chests which takes away from earning coins so it's harder to make game progress as if you win the treasure chest games (which is a lot), you don't earn any coins, so purchasing game items for your tank becomes almost impossible which initially was the purpose of the entire game. It ends up not being the game you started playing. Sucks!

Initially quite fun but very quickly became impossible to continue without spending $3.99 for a tool to pass a level. Couldn't go any further otherwise and no way to win enough points/coins/upgrades to proceed. Deleted it and moved on to more fun, less profitable for the company, games. Please note that the game keeps trying to get your Facebook login and contacts and your Google login. On the day immediately following deleting it, I was presented with an ad saying the fish "missed me" Creepy!

out of the many other games i have played, this game comes close to the top of the 'sneaky' list. this game has been cleverly engineered for the user to spend money. it could be very addictive to the vulnerable. so, be warned. the game can be entertaining but, there is nothing random about the way the pieces drop into place. the powerups usually land exactly in the worst possible place....very frustrating. the treasure hunts and fish worlds are quite good but, again, engineered to bankrupt you

Disgusted! I've played this game happily for many years but feel super cheated now. I always buy a gold pass but if this isn't fixed I won't be spending any more money. 1 week pass for the same price as a month has always been? While I've always been able to justify spending a fiver a month, there is no way I can justify or afford to quadruple that to 20, especially during the current cost of living crisis! What a rotten scam fishdom and great way to lose dedicated long time players!!

Don't pay for this game, don't even trust it. I paid money to ensure I never lost a game to keep my reoccuring bomb. Then it vanished and I had none of my items I paid for. After being stuck on a hard level for a few days, the game keeps encouraging me to "spend more". Im done! My items suddenly disappeared and I feel ripped off. Uninstalled.

I've been playing this game almost daily for just over 2 years and I'm on level 16351. The latest update is truly awful! The game pass cost has risen 50%, and power ups are woeful as they have been reduced. Lots of the existing power ups I had have now gone. I will not be playing anymore but I'll check back every now and then to see if the makers of the game have seen sense and revert back to what it was.

The game that was advertised and the game you get are completely different. This is basically bedazzled but with ocean-related symbols instead of jewels, which is NOT what I was expecting. Plus, I earned a whole lot of gems (needed for various things in-game) and they get stored in a "piggy bank"..... which you can only access if you pay real world money for it.

Same as every other game. Mini game to play to get points to buy things to continue game. But the game isn't like the adds and neither is the game within the game. Every 2 or 3 rounds you get a minimisin game and it goes for 2 seconds. It's needs to be more then that. Also they keep changing the main game so you finally buy fish you like and feeding them and they add stupid new characters and don't let you see or play with your fish anymore. I give 2 stars instead of 1 cause it could be worse?

I’ve been playing Fishdom for a long time, but with every update it just keeps getting worse. The game’s algorithm feels like it’s deliberately blocking progress unless you spend money. Sometimes you end up stuck on the same level for two weeks, which becomes incredibly boring. It honestly feels like the game is trying to force you into buying boosters or extra moves just to move forward. This isn’t fun anymore — it’s frustrating and exhausting.

FALSE ADVERTISING! While the advert shows the game as helping the fish to escape and avoid obstacles or pull pins out to save the fish, this is not what happens in the game. It is simply a match 3 game and that's it. You either have to spend money to buy lives, power ups and gems and get the piggy bank or you have to repeat levels over and over. In total the game is a massive lie about what you will be playing and not worth playing

I really like playing this game. But when you have to wait 30 to 60 mins for a life after you use 5 is just absolutely ridiculous. The ad is different from what the game actually is. So that's a downfall in itself. Instead of rewarding us with gems ect we have to purchase them which is just out of order. Developers need to re-think the way they have designed this game.

With the new update, it's more difficult to keep going on the levels. You pass a Hard level, next it's normal, and next, it's again Hard level. The exploration game, I'll never finished because in the beginning, cost 5 lights and then, cost over 40. If continue like this, I have to uninstall it. I'm not enjoying this game anymore.

Update 4 yrs l8r: still playing & on a good team, however be prepared to pay to play or be on a good team. the latest update now gives you less rewards & costs more. I refuse to spend any more money so time is now limited to continue. Have been playing for months. Enjoy the game but was initially misleading as to what the game actually is. If you aren't prepared to pay as you play you will be forever stuck on levels. Addictive game when playing with an amazing team that is competitive.

If you like basic matching games then it's not too bad. But you know the ads? The ones where you gradually eat bigger and bigger fish? Looked like a fun concept? Well I'm on level 100 now and that has come up one single time. Like I said it's alright as a matching game, although a bit basic. But if you're here based on the ads you've seen then just leave it.

I was really enjoying the game and the variety of levels and puzzles, but like it's cousin Gardenscapes, the mechanics are the same and mini games are basically the same also. Biggest gripe, however, is the levels are geared to ultimately start making you spend real 💰 to get past them. And the concept of earning gems but having them locked in a piggybank that you have to pay real 💰 to unlock is evil. There is already a mechanism in game to buy gems with money, so let us keep what we earn!!!

I have enjoyed this game for a long time now. Most complaints on here are legit, but I still played and enjoyed. Whenever an opportunity came up to buy the gold pass option, and then just recently it switched from lasting a very long time to a week. So for this reason, I'm dropping my rating. I will reach out to support regarding my personal information and then I will be deleting the app.

Well, you see something in the advertisement and find something so much different in the game. When you play the game you find the difficulty of some levels doesn't make any sense at all and depend only on paying money to continue, after some time the game becomes very boring and nothing new. One more thing I can add that the game doesn't have any moral benefits or goals more than wasting your time and money.

Love it so much. Just one little thing I would change. I wish you could take a fish from one tank and add it to another tank. Other than that its a great game. Also want to know why the add is not the same as the game itself?? I had to delete the game due to my phone playing up. Saw the add for the game and thought wow that different now. So downloaded the game again and found out that it was the same as before. Why are the ads so different from the game???

Disappointed! Saw ad that showed a game of skill. You had to choose which pin to move and order to keep fish safe. I haven't seen that gave or level anywhere. Instead the game is more like candy crush and buying fish things. False advertising. Unable to contact help. Must choose a help option, but none apply. Don't download have if u want to rest your skill. Very upset

This is a match-3+ game. If I knew that every level was going to be like Candy Crush, I would never have downloaded this game. I'm sorry to the developers for being so harsh but your advert is deceiving. I had to delete your game because I had enough of the repetitive nature of the game. Just because the fish can be fed and the items can be added to the fish tanks, this does not make up for the lack of diversity in the game itself.

GAME NOT AS ADVERTISED!! It shows a fish and a shark trapped in two different sections and you have to work out which rods to pull in which order to release the fish......NO. It's a match 3 game with a fish tank which you can decorate with the money you win. As match 3 games go, it's bog standard power ups etc but the aquarium stuff is just too childish for me. I was looking forward to playing a puzzle game and this is NOT A PUZZLE GAME.

The game used to be fun and relaxing. After they realized that money could come easily with the option of selling GOLDEN PASSES, it became stressful and frustrating. Without a golden pass, you get stuck on the same game for weeks until the game itself decides to help you and bombs appear in bulks out of nowhere. I used to play it every day, now, when I get stuck, I simply forget about it for a week, then try again, and so on. SHAME ON YOU, developers.

It's just too hard. Initially you get hooked, but after reaching level 100+, unless you buy powerups, it really takes days to clear one level. Even my mom, who usually loves these types of games, got sick of it. I would not recommend the game to anybody. Just get a different matching game where you can play for hours. Seems that the developers aren't taking the feedback seriously too because when I wrote this, there's like 50 reviews saying the same.

Why do you have to update the game every few days? It's not like there's any difference. Then sometimes you're forced to take certain decisions you don't want to before you play the game. And yes, it's a misleading game. I downloaded it only to find out it's actually candy crush in another background, meanwhile, the main game i wanted is just a mini game that comes up once in a blue moon. So annoying!

The designs are beautiful, and overall is a very good game, but it is not relaxing. While games should be relaxing, this game is furtstrating most of the time because levels are very hard to pass.You need diamonds which are difficult to have. Also, with the update, the game has removed also the mini games where you could have some minutes of unlimited lives, and the boosters are not the same.

I've played this for years, got that far I run out of levels, but it's really getting monotonous, it's the same side game over and over, used to be different ones, I carried on playing, however, I went on today and they've changed it, the boosters are different and not as good, also, the season price has gone up £3, sorry guys but I'm out, I've uninstalled and won't be coming back.

Another money making app. Starts off amazing. Fun to play. Relaxing. Then all of a sudden becomes impossible to continue unless you buy stuff. I don't mind buying a game like this for around €5. But these games are designed to make you spend lots of money. I don't want a challenging game to get stressed and spend bulks of money. I want a game to relax.

I have been misled to download this game thinking it was a different kind of game. I was playing other game and saw the ad for fishdom therefore downloaded this game. The ad I saw was moving sticks around and burning the fish and sharks etc, trying to escape from other predators. This game is basically feeding fishes and then candy crush???? Game is OK but will not be playing further as your ad is misleading and completely different.

in the last few weeks I have lost my super lightning without closing the game or restarting and when i contact the support, they gaslight me saying you must have closed the game or restarted or something else. it is very frustrating. and again, I was just playing the game and put down the phone for a minute and when I opened it, I was logged out and surely enough, when I opened the game the super lightning was gone. and of course it would be a waste of time to contact support.

If I could I would give no stars. Playrix has increased costs, less rewards. It is hard to pass levels unless you spend. They have changed rewards and boosters making to harder to get through a level. The cost of gold pass play has gone up. You can no longer get lives from Facebook friends. I won't spend, so I struggle to move through the levels. If it was not for my team players, I would give up. If you play this game, do not spend as it could cost you a fortune.

The game itself is kinda fun but it's insanely annoying how it always pushes you to do things when trying to just enjoy yourself. All these notes popping up block the view of your fish tank, too. Also, the ads that made me download it show a totally different style of game than what you actually end up doing. 100% misleading. I checked out other games from this company and as it seems that is just their thing. Huge disappointment.

Started playing again. Still not very user friendly, and now with the new upgrade, I've lost my booster's. With the games being very difficult, poor reward system and designed by some evil minded warp toad, it remains to be seen if I'll continue playing. Perhaps the old maxim, if it ain't broke don't fix it, if something they've never heard of?

The ads are totally misleading. If you're here for the advertised minigames, forget it, you'll spend less than 1% of your time on that. It's basically standard "move-blocks-to-rows-so-they-vanish" and after the first levels (teasers) some become ultra hard to do without spending extras (cash). For the advertised minigames? most of them i've never seen after a few hundred levels ingame. but the fish are cute. tl;dr: stay away from this fraud!!

I got kicked out of level 7 of carnival of gifts because of a glitch which I have a screenshot of. There was one scroll 📜 of paper left to find and it was nowhere when all the bottles were open. It could have been alright if I played the game for free but I have purchased diamond to be able to reach this level and the situation does not seem fair to me. One of the worst tech support I have ever seen. If you enter a wrong section to complain - you can't leave it.

Great effects, usually fun to play but this game often keeps you stuck on levels, particularly if you get a 2 hour unlimited lives reward. Eg - if you have to catch a # of squid to win and just need a couple more, if they're not ready to let you pass, they just stop putting squid on the board. You still have to move, so you do until you lose because there's no way to win.

One of the worst games I've ever played. Stats fine but yuen it gets impossible to play without boosters. Plus you have to pay for the rewards that you WON. Just a filthy money making tactic. The game developers seem to be lunatics considering the kind of levels that you get after a certain point. I'd rather watch my money burn than spend on this stupid game. Moreover, the game is not at all like it has been advertised. RIDICULOUS!

First let me just start with the fact this game is not what's advertised. The game once you start playing it can be addictive though. Mostly a fun game to get lost in but some level are just unnecessarily difficult to force you to buy extras for help. Aside from it not being what's advertised, and the huge swings in difficulty from one level to the next, I'd be lying if I said I don't play this game alot despite all that.

The latest update no longer allows the player to restart the level once it's started. It's a tremendously disappointing decision that the game developing team has ever made as it simply discourages players to continue playing the game. It seems the team is running out of ways to squeeze money from players, who used to have the pathetically petty advantage to have the opportunity to start a level in a comparatively painless manner. The fun of the game simply disappeared.

I do love this game. Just passed level 1000 (I know, Welsh lockdown seemed to have gotten to me). I haven't spent a single penny on it. Yes it's very annoying and drives me crazy when I get stuck on a level for weeks at a time but meh so what. Get there eventually. My kids (7&8) love it too. To be honest the only negative is the turtle that talks toy you, you can't skip past to just play levels. But it soenst stop me from coming back

I'm going off this game, sadly. I've played it for years but I'm unhappy with the last update. The changing of the bombs and combos you can start with. It's made it harder to complete levels, I'm guessing that was the point, we're completing levels faster than you can make them? I miss the fishy side games too. The explorer map games are getting boring, they could be replaced with longer versions of the little games that were stopped. Please make this game better again.

I used to love this game, but recent changes have made it much less enjoyable. As others have said the new changes to the seasons not only means it's near impossible to earn any rewards due to constant hard levels, but it also costs 4x more. My other issue is that almost daily a message pops up to say I need to make space to play, but I know full well that there is space on my phone. This stops me from being able to play altogether. Also team rewards should be shared by active players only imho.

This game is a scam. The minigames they advertise are only available after spending lots of time playing another game that is not advertised. It is the same like Evoy The king returns. They are a game much different than the game they advertise. So, if you watched the ads of the fish eating other fishes and you think that is all this game is gonna be, you gonna be fooled. If that were the main game, it would be ok. But the main game is another different thing. Not what you see in the ads.

I've been playing this game for years, then few years ago it got stucked after updates and then I quit it completely because there was no fix. I recently came back again only to see it reduced drastically in level moves and it became extremely frustrating. Yeah, you can pass levels even with small amounts of moves but It isn't fun and games are supposed to be fun. We are paying you for seasons and other stuff, you shouldn't be bitchy and greedy about it.

I like this game but agree with those saying the ads for it are misleading. The reason I got it was to play a little fish using math to chomp on big fish. Instead it's a match 3 game. And before you say "minigames", I'm on my 4th aquarium, played dozens of mini games. Only TWO have been a fish chompers. ALL the others are pull-a-pin-out challenges. Anyway, it's a fun game, but I wanted to play the one advertised.

Firstly, the ads for this game make it look like a simple maths puzzle game when in reality it's actually just a match 3 game with "mini games", not as advertised. Also, I had to uninstall a bunch of things to have enough space to play this, then after playing for an hour or so and then coming back to it later, I suddenly needed more than twice as much extra space as I needed to install in the first place. Uninstalled.

The adverts for this game are missleading. The game is not what you expected from the ads. This is a basic match three type of game. I am horrified that this kind of false advertising still goes on. The game is not impressive. rather dull actually. If you advertise a certain type of game, please deliver. I have had the same experiences from your other games. All falsley advertised. Not impressed and will not recomend. shame on you!

Fun while it lasted, game ends up becoming pay to win: As you reach the higher levels, the game becomes un-fun as you get stuck on levels that often take 50+ attempts to pass without using many powerups which you often have to purchase. I get the feeling that it is programmed to be rigged. I've spent too much money on this game often times chasing something thay really doesn't matter e.g. achieving or attaining something in the game. Gameplay is fun with lots of variety but I had to uninstall.

Just another pay to play app. It's fun enough but there comes a point when you can't progress without spending money. I was happy to buy this game on Big Fish Games for a fixed price but this is ridiculous. Uninstalled. Thanks Devs your money grubbing got you precisely NOTHING. Oh and the mini games are pathetic. You can just keep trying until you get it right.

I really love this game and so does my 7 year old HOWEVER once you start to get to the highest levels it is really hard to continue without spending money. I have played this for over a year and still have not unlocked past the third lot of aquariums. also it is impossible to get enough gold vouchers/coupons to buy some of the cool specialty fish. Basically the game is great and the graphics awesome but it sucks you into spending money all the time to get further - getting too expensive.

Very interesting game. Beautiful graphics and each aquarium has lovely different designs which you can decorate, so don't go buying everything that pops up. Take your time and choose what belongs in each aquarium. Some improvements can be made with regards to the rewarding system. All in all I'm very happy with it and it got me off my Candy Crush addiction.

Excellent game, fun to play and although it can take quite a few go's to beat levels, it is possible to do so, without purchasing any jewels. The tasks can enable you to build up coins and jewels. The new teams are a great idea - but it's a shame the levels are based on your current level on fishdom. I think it would've been better if it was a separate game and team members could build up scores from playing team games / feeding fish, with rewards in the form of bombs etc instead of just lives.

A case of a developer turn greedy over time. stuck on a level that was once 25 moves and now down to 15 moves, near impossible with no boosters, shows how greedy they have become over time just to force you to pay to complete things. Even 9 crystals for 5 measly extra moves is greedy. The game was fun up to that point, and even got me thinking "hey i could pay and support this game it doesn't seem greedy". Then all in a single day it shows its true colors. Great way to ruin a classic. No thnx.

Just at level 4, the game froze and would not respond. I clicked every possible button but it wouldn't navigate me anywhere. When I tried to go on with the puzzle it wouldn't let me because I had finished all my prompts but it wouldn't let me pass onto the next level either. I only downloaded it for old times sake when it used to be that one game with the fish trying to eat each other but I didn't even get to play it because of this bs.

Hopeless - ads show great game, but what you get is an hour before you get ONE GAME, followed by another, seemingly endless non-essential stuff, then another ONE GAME. THIS REPEATS, ON, AND ON. Don't even think of installing, will end up uninstalling. This applies ALL SIMILAR TO THE SO-CALLED, GAMES - I FINALLY SAW THE BIT ABOUT THIS, was barely can see it, disappears in 0.0005 seconds! Could, if I do, give 0-Stars.

Free game that costs a lot. The logic puzzles that are featured heavily in the ads are only in the very early game. I saw three and got 400 levels into the game. The game is simply matching 3 or more symbols to clear obstacles in levels. The game manipulates players to purchase gems at a high cost. I mostly played this very late at night since I have insomnia which is severe. At those times my defenses were low and I would often buy then. I would not do so if i was playing when fully awake.

I absolutely love decorating aquariums idea. But levels are IMPOSSIBLE to clear, EVEN IF I USED BOOSTERS. And minigames THAT THEY USED TO ADVERTISE THE APP can BARELY seen in the actual game. I can only say this because I actually constantly in a few days. Maybe if the developer use less budget in advertisement, they wouldn't be this greedy and people can actually enjoy the game. IF YOU'RE NOT BORN RICH, RUN!

To start with i highly enjoyed the game but found the higher levels extremely difficult 80+. i am bow stuck on 156. even purchasing diamonds and extra time didn't help on some levels. and how much should we have to pay to be able to play a game?reviews of the game from other players confirms this is a difficult game. i am not the only one having this problem. unfortunately i have given up and will have to just uninstall.

Money grab, and just getting more greedy each update. No more lightning w/ dynamite, no more mini games, smaller rewards during expeditions, prices jumping and the way they label levels is inaccurate: sometimes a "super hard" level is easy, making you waste boosters. They used to tell you the goal for the level so you could get an idea of how hard it really was, not any more. THEN when you email to complain, they say "It improves the balance of game, giving players more chances to win" LIES

I really used to enjoy this game and it used to bring my stress levels down. But lately this game has become very very unfair, exhausting and stressful. Almost every other level is hard or super hard level and it takes days or weeks to pass a level. They have also cut down on the number of moves and its impossible to play this game without paying a lot for the boosters. This time I did not get any free hours too!! They have become more greedy for money. Will have to delete this game!

I've played for years and it was fun. The last couple of months, I have to play for about 5 days to win one level. When choosing lightning or bombs, it get placed on a spot where it's inaccessible, or get frozen immediately and cannot be used until the last 3 moves. Why do u make it so hard? It get super boring after the second day of playing the same board. Losing interest and I've been playing for YEARS!

Firstly, I have been playing fishdom for 11 years, and it is my favorite game, but now the levels are impossible to beat. There are too many objectives with too few moves. The prices of things have also gotten out of hand. I'm at level 16415 now, and I can not seem to get further. This game was really fun for a long time, but now the game is just too much. Playrix, please fix this problem, and please make everything cheaper. Thank you

Not what I expected, but still fun. The game they use for advertisement is available as minigame after level 2324. Minigames are very easy, so would not recommend to play the game for that. It's a match-3 game, where you cannot play previous levels. At a certain point, the levels can get pretty hard and I personally like the challenge. I reached level 2390 today without spending money. Fun game, but do not expect the game to be as advertised.

It's a fun game but once you get to a certain level every about 5 or 6 levels is so difficult it is impossible to complete without purchasing extras. The coins and tickets you earn on each level can only be used to buy stuff for your aquarium, not anything to help you pass levels. So you have to keep spending money to keep playing which is a con.

I'm on the level where you race other players to the finishing line. Since I have started it only yesterday the game no longer works. I can't play anything. I've lost 10 hours of 3 playing. It won't even let me contact help. It is not responding to anything. I have uninstalled and installed it more than once. I've shut it down and restarted it. Nothing has changed. Worked so hard with my team only for it to just not work. So angry 😠 right now. If I could, I wouldn't even give it 1 star. Fix it.

I like the fish, how they interact. But that can't save the game from being repetitive, and boring after the first 40 or so levels, as every action takes forever. Most of the decorations in and for the aquariums are an eyesore. Not to mention that the promised minigames suddenly stop, and so do the bonuses. Yes... and there're some bugs as well, and no way to contact the developers.

Another game where the advert is a tiny portion of the game you're forced to play. I just wanted to be a little fish eating bigger and bigger fish, but that was one minigame in ten, with the main game unable to choose whether it's offbrand candy crush, offbrand Spyro the dragon, or an aquarium decoration zone. Super misleading and frustrating in the long run.

I'm changing my review. This has been my favourite game for over the last year or two, but recently there have been negative changes to the additional boosts, particularly the seahorse that comes around every few days. I have a policy of not paying actual money for games. I just play until I've exhausted all possibilities. I've reached that point now. I used to be able to win on skill/patience, but now it feels like I'm being 'encouraged' (forced) to pay. I think I'm done with Fishdom.

Not sure how many stars to give the game really. I have uninstalled the game yet again after being on level 5211. I've played this game for a few years now and its always my go back to game, but if you like a game of skill don't bother, having played it for so long now ive seen so many times how it can keep you on a level for a few days before it decides to let you complete it. Today I had completed a level but told me I still had one more item to collect so couldn't progress.

The game as such is great sofar but there are two things that is just not cool: what you see in the ads for this game is NOT what you will be doing for the most part, so it feels a bit miseading and not what I signed up for. Secondly, the annoying little additional tasks that keep poping up, like having to clean your screen and feed the fish... I mean, what is that???

Got baited. Downloaded after viewing several ads showing a seemingly interesting puzzle game, but the first 15 levels are just a cheap candy crush rip-off, coupled with a boring tutorial component presumably geared towards getting the player to engage with the store. Unfortunately this type of game baiting has become all too common these days, but I suppose that's to be expected with developers struggling to monetise apps in the free-to-play economy. Just a prime example of a sad reality.

If I could give zero stars here, I would. The levels become insanely difficult and you have to rely on luck, boosters, and gems to play. A lot of levels have been changed over time. Where a year ago a level would have 24 moves, now it's 10. The game is good, it just gets frustrating to play and sitting on one level for days on end is ridiculous.

I downloaded this game because I saw it's Ad many times in my other games. Unfortunately this game it NOT AT ALL as advertised. I have experienced this with a lot of games advertised in other apps where the advertisement looks fun then you download it and they are all basically the same as candy crush but you earn coins to build an aquarium and buy fish. Same as in Gardenscapes but you build a house instead. Decent games but fix the completely false advertising please.

The levels get progressively harder and some easy levels require days to go through but possible without spending money. However, the ad about fish fighting its way to a superboss with insane level only happened twice in over a hundred levels and overall these puzzles are not really different. What pisses me off is the INSANE amount of event ads (which I don't even bother to play). Some of them can't even be skipped and that eats your infinite life time. Same with Garden and Homescapes

Was fun in the start, played a lot and even paid for stuff including the monthly pass. But eventually it just became too pay to win. The levels have too few moves you have to have extras to beat them(which you have to pay for then). Very addictive game and well done they got some money out of me but took it too far. Kept it less obnoxiously pay to win and i might have stuck around and spent more. Deleted now. Also the game is nothing like the ads or picture, thats just a mini game inside.

Really getting bored with this game now! Unless you are prepared to spend a lot of money to get the various power ups it is almost impossible to make progress. The seasons used to enable you to get power ups free but they have disappeared! Any extra time must be used immediately or lost! Mini-games, another source of bonuses also seem to have disappeared! I gave up on it once before then came back in lockdown, now I am injured so play for entertainment. When I get fit again will leave for good!

Too many intrusive pop-up that interrupt you,.and/or redirect you to various other parts and very slow unskipable animations of whatever they want to show you. If you have 5 free minutes for a quick level, you're going to waste them on these interruptions. Just let me play the game and don't force me to click on whatever. Just add the button in the interface with the red dot to get my attention whenever I want to check that out.

Okay, I'm at level 3100, still havent spent a cent on it. Every level is beatable, I got lots of diamonds and boosters, but only use them for fun. Believe me, every single level might be completed as it is, w/o boosters or platinum rachel. Well, sometimes you have to be something more than a human to control the random moment, but hey, what are you all here for?

I have not installed this game in particular but I have downloaded similar one gardenscapes. Please remember this that the ads of these games make it look so easy. But in fact you need coins to perform each activity and you win each coin by clearing some levels of candy crush like game within this game. Difficulty increases level by level and the player will be given limited options if they fail a level, which I find annoying. So, I am not interested in this game and I won't download.

The first thing to say is that this is definitely not candy crush. Sure, you move candy-looking objects into patterns which then explode and you get combos of four or more which then give you boosters and allow you to explode more candy-looking items and the more explosions you get he more bonuses your get and you eventually run out of lives, more of which can then be purchased for real money to fulfil your need to get to the next level on an endless quest to win. But this has fish tanks.

I tried it after seeing an ad, which describes this games as a puzzle. Just like the "where is my water" game. But after installing, this is just another useless time wasting game. It is always better to buy a real aquarium. Games should be something that we can't do in real life. This one is just a candy crush, but inside a fish tank. Don't even bother trying ....

ORIGINAL POST very addictive. Can't stop playing it. Doesn't get boring as always extra side games to play. Can require in app purchases though to clear higher levels. EDIT I would now suggest that you avoid this app. It takes a lot of money to get through many of the levels levels now. The developers have reduced the number of moves available so it is becoming even more difficult to pass a level - and it's almost impossible to progress through the levels without spending money to get boosters etc. No longer fun when you spend hours/days or weeks just to pass one level Lots of people online saying the same thing.

Really enjoy the game. But there is sometimes an issue with the controls. If I swipe the piece one direction, it goes another direction and completely messes up my plan and I'm unable to complete the level in that round, where if it allowed the piece to go the direction I requested, I would gain a bomb, or the bomb would explode where I need it to. Please fix this, because it's highly annoying

fish bank should be free!!!! does not make sense to collect it full and than only to buy what you collected!!!! seriously this game is getting boring as well it's like repeating the levels at different levels again, be more creative with the stages add new challenges or make transitions in the pieces or something! anything! and FISHBANK SHOULD BE OPEN FOR FREE!!!! WE COLLECTED IT, ITS OURS!!!!!! because I will never buy it no matter what its ridiculous who spends money on a game cummon!

Great game but some not so great updates. They changed the power ups so where you once got a lightning and dynamite combined, you only get a dynamite now. So everyone who bought these would have lost value when it changed. It has made some levels almost impossible without buying loads of extras, but I guess that's why they've done it. It would be good if you could buy power ups and diamonds using the coins you earn instead of diamonds that cost physical money.

Like other reviewers, I was drawn to this game by the Save The Fish adverts. As with others of its kind, it's nothing of the sort, with only a few Save The Fish minigames early on to justify the adverts and stave off any false advertising litigation. Once I got to level 60 and hadn't encountered a minigame for about 40 levels I uninstalled the game.

I came from an advertisment and was excited to play, i saw the reviews but downloaded anyway because i wanted to see if the game is still good despite the false advertisment. I am greatly disapointed in it. I didn't like the game at all. It's a candy crush type of game and not a tunnel game. It could have been at least save the fish kind of game. This is VERY different from what they showed on the advertisment. Really disapointed. EDIT 26/01/22 : I rechecked and nothing has changed in the game.

I downloaded this as I saw it from an ad (didn't click on ad) those ads and what the game is are two very different things I should have known better. In any case this was not want o thought it would be. I thought you go around and eat bigger fish and level up it is not it's basicay like jewel blitz. I uninstalled won't reinstall. I wish you could just play the "mini games"

Nothing like the ad that convinced me to try it. Really rather silly which is fine but I found it hard to figure out even the most basic level and it was super boring. I really would have liked to play the game in the ad where you try to navigate the fish through a maze, by trying to direct it safely and avoid danger but I guess I'm too dumb to get to that level because I couldn't even figure out level 1, which doesn't even have a fish and involved clearing coins like in bejeweled. Uninstalled:(

Just uninstalled. Really fun and addictive game. Puzzles are well done and are fun to complete. At some levels you are given a ridiculously low amount of moves just to make sure you waste all your boosts and bonuses, or have to purchase some. Sometimes I feel the bonuses at the beginning of the levels are more like a nuisance in they way they are placed. I've wasted enough time on this and I'm sure the devs won't miss me since I didn't have them a penny. It was fun while it lasted.

What is with all the glitches all of a sudden!!!!! Why do i have to re log into facebook, i never logged out, and I've never put in my facebook password before so please fix it!!!! Fishdom, the game with 45 pop ups before you can feed your fish! Cute game, some levels are Very very hard! Quite hard to get 3 stars on each tank also, and too much to put in tank before you get another star, it's looking too crowded! Please make it an offline game

I ❤️ this game!! It's so much fun to play the levels and gained coins and vouchers to decorate the tanks. Rewards are good after winning levels, completed tidal tasks, joined the challenges and even small tasks like feeding the fish and clean up the aquarium. The only downside is the gold voucher is very rare so it is annoying to have to wait for so long to buy the special fish. But in overall this game is highly recommended.

Sadly it's a Pay-to-win game. Once you cross 80+ levels, you are going to have a hard time progressing. Events are a good way to get perks, which will help you to advance multiple levels at ease, but the problem is to progress in event, you need to complete the levels you stuck in. Sometimes you will get rewards at the wrong time and you can't do anything because you don't have any more lives to play. This game is heavily dependent on micro transactions. And it's not cheap!

Was a great game but have to agree with the majority here. It's too many hard levels forcing you to buy items to get through. And now it 9 gems to carry on a game instead of 6. Sigh. When you Google how to get through a level the examples are often the same level but with more moves. They seem to make it harder than the original level just to show it can be done and then they make it almost impossible but cutting the move count.

I love this game I'm somewhere level 4000+ I do wish that there was an option for us to dlt special aquariums& that the story book aquariums were put to better use or also could be dlted, after the challenge was complete. This game could be so much more. Online 2 player games for instance? I am a loyal player I pay R99 almost every month. But if it goes higher I may not. R99 is way to expensive & we can't sell our games like RPG players do. But anyways it's an awesome pass game.

Installed it based on a false add. But as it had been a while since I had a match 3 game installed decided I might play it anyway. Starts off okay with the level indication to get you into it I guess, but at some stage the "easy" games become more difficult than the hard ones just to get you to buy power-ups.

I've played for a long time and I dont pay to play. Never have, never will! Some levels are near impossible to get through and trying to beat the level for days on end is BORING, un-inviting, a turn-off and absolutely frustrating. It's disgusting that many levels have dropped in the number of moves. Terrible game play by the developers!

I downloaded Fishdom with high hopes based on its advertised features, only to find myself sorely disappointed. The game fell far short of the enticing promises made in its advertisements. Love it. But annoyed that you have to buy to unlock prizes like the diamonds you already earned. And that I'm upto level 1000+ and I've only played about 4 mini games .. they are quick and easy. Very unsatisfying. A marketing ploy to get you to down load game. Good thing is... the game itself is great. When they have seasons... easier to play as there are more prizes available.

Good match 3 game. With the gems you win you buy fish and objects, plants for your aquariums. U only come across the mini-games wen u finish a tank.. I tried this because of a pop-up ad that showed a fish being guided to safety. Looked interesting and probably would be, if that were what the game is about. Sadly it's just level after level of a variation on bejewelled and countless other match the tiles games. If that's what blows your skirt up I'm sure there are better offerings. This is just boring.

This game like many others is advertised as one thing and when you bother to download it is not what you expected. You advertise everywhere that this is a game of trying to set free a captured fish through moving levers and walls....but when you download it is no ot that at all,but rather a matching game like Candy Crush. Its a good game. But there is some miss advertising.. the main thing they showed that got me interested is not what the game is about. Actually that really ever happens.. where you get to choose a pin to pull and save or endanger the fish.. However it's a captivating game. I deleted it because at one point you will no longer be able to pass levels unless you put in your credit card info and pay for lives and advantages.

On Thursday while I was playing, I got a message that "New levels coming soon". It's Friday today and still New levels are not loaded on my device, & I can't play. It's weird and Frustrating. I have been playing for 7 years. Come on, I have to play for my Team tournament today and still not updated.

Not happy 😔 I've been playing this game for a few years and always enjoyed it until recently, so many changes and not for the better! I've always bought the Gold Pass but not any more, they've lowered the rewards considerably and yet the price stays the same!
