I will not spend any more money until this changes!!

Saw the ad in another game but due to the ridiculous amount of false advertising I'm seeing lately, I thought I would check the reviews. Surprise surprise, its nothing like the actual gameplay. I havent even bothered to install it - as soon as I read it's a match 3 I was bored. The advertising literally couldn't be any more different to the game. Reported

I've been playing this for years and used to really enjoy it plus buy passes each month. However, they've made it so difficult; cut game pass time and jacked the price. You can't pass later levels without buying boosters, despite them saying they can all be beaten without boosters, is just an outright lie. Even 1 hr free playing and you can't pass without boosters? it's not even fun anymore, it's just GREED. Don't waste your time. Sucks you in for money...

Misleading ad, generally boring. I would recommend maybe for your toddler kids at best. The puzzles in the game consist of common sense decisions, like, is 15 bigger than 10? Or match 3 games like candy crush, or that minigame that you see in many other mobile game ads where you have to choose what to do, sounds better on paper than in practice, trust me Edit. I give 2 stars instead of 1 as the game does not shower you with ads, I only played for 15 minutes and had enough, for you might differ

At first, thought I'd give a chance to developer even though I got scammed because the game is different with the ads. So I start to play, but as the time goes on, the stage starting to get impossible, like only give 8 move to clear challenge level. As if they forcing you to pay for the diamond, powerups or etc. Plus they nerfed the booster for stage. Now I can't enjoy this puzzle game anymore. Uninstalled, developer you really are shameful for me.

FALSE ADVERTISING. The ads that show a game where a small fish eats and gets progressively bigger IS NOT the core game. I saw others say that it's a mini game sprinkled throughout the actual game(just a match 3 game), but that's still false advertising. The developers or the PR team reply to people saying "it's actually in the game, you just have to beat some levels" or something else that misses the point. But it's simple: advertise the core game or make the core game what you advertise.

This is a fun and addictive game. New events come up evry 15 days and is a little expensive and even after that you will only get bonuses if you clear levels. I am currently on level 5600. At times i get stuck on a level for days and there is nothing I can do in the game. Then it becomes boring & its time to delete the game. The new update just reduced the boosters! instead of 2 black bombs, there is only one, and even the red one comes without the yellow one! WHY!!!

So if you have come here after watching the ad for this game then let me stop you right there because it is actually a candy crush game. Yes, it sounds weird because ad was showing something completely different right? Trust me it's not that, it's candy crush. You play kinda candy crush game to get coins then you build your aquarium. That's the game. Fake advertising.

Love this game I've been playing it for about 2yrs and i simply cannot get through the day without playing it... It makes me feel relaxed.. i would only love it more if each fish tank didn't require such a lot of points (stars) before the next one is unlocked i get bored looking at the same tanks for so long and i would love to get more fishes. Waiting 30 round to get one fish does not seem fair...

Best aquarium-style game I've found. Love the new Aquatasks update. No shortage of goals to achieve. Really enjoyed this game since I started. I like how you can customize each aquarium and the variety of fish to collect. Ability to customize each aquarium is almost endless. Many levels are just challenging enough and a few are very difficult but definitely keeps the game interesting.

This is a great game, but I feel the developers have just gotten too greedy, They changed the gold tickets from $10.99AUD a month to now $7.99 a week! You can't pass some levels without spending money, I've spent so much on this game, and they just keep making things harder or adding more cost to the game. I will keep playing for now, but I refuse to spend anymore money on the game just to line the developers pockets.

Love the game, i dread to think about the amount of money I would spend to advance in the game, give the poor people a chance, the way things are going the world is doomed, keef.. well I can Admit it was not the case of the end of the world. There is still a chance. I've got a sore thumb trying to advance the game.slow going with not spending any money. Update, I have found out that it costs £1200 to complete all the levels. I don't spend money on games. I don't know if it is value for money.. x

I do love this game and will continue to play, however, there are a few issues. 1) downloading updates - sometimes takes forever, if downloads at all. I've had to delete the game and reinstall. Lost everything including my team and had to start from the beginning. 2) there is money required to progress through levels once over 1000 level. I have been stuck on a level for weeks. There is no way unless you have Jewells or back up bombs, etc that you would get through without spending money.

Been playing this game since it's inception (stopped for about a year), however, in recent times there are too many updates, alot of hidden difficult levels (yellow level extremely difficult to win), extra difficult levels every 3 levels and some impossible to beat unless you purchase a lot of gems/diamonds. I really don't see the need for all this struggle on a game which I once used as a relaxation method. I deducted my star rating and I'm really contemplating uninstalling.

I love this game as I've played it for years but I'm so disappointed as I feel they have gotten greedy with their prices. You used to get 50 credit but now 30 credit for the same price and also you are not getting the deal or credit the same price as before they have risen the prices up. I won't be buying the credits while they are expensive. Such a shame as it was my favourite all time game. Did think on unistalling due to their greed.

Not the game I signed up for so this in itself is this was deceptive. Like mentioned in numerous feedback, game needs a lot of time for cleaning tanks etc. Some levels are impossible without buying packs. I deleteeld the game as I was receiving intrusive sound push notifications at all hours. After I deleted it, I received heavy advertising on Flipboard to "Come back" which I deemed to be inappropriate & flagged as such. Now they are back with no option to flag only download. So Wrong!

The game was promoted as a puzzle where slides were pushed or pulled to move water or poison to a keep a fish alive, or to kill it. Whereas the actual game is just another version of Candy Crush where you clear levels to collect coins to buy fish, weeds and ornaments for your aquarium. I played 32 levels and then deleted it. Although graphics were good, I'm disappointed that this is not the game that i thought I'd be playing!

A fun time wasting game but a few annoying features... Squid levels, the squid are less inclined to appear when you're close to completion. There are times when doing well is actually detrimental. You cannot chose when to use your rewards. The allocation of when you get a bronze/silver/gold ticket seems totally random, it'd make much more sense if all basic levels gave bronze, hard silver and extra hard gold.

The game has become so graphics rich that it has a hard time loading. There are so many events that you have to click through a lot of stuff before you can even get to the point of loading a level. Still playing. It is less fun when you get past about level 800 because you fail levels more often. I have spent 25 or more tries on some. Often want to play for 15 minutes or so and the first 5 are spent dealing with popups of different challenges etc. Too much so recently.

Edit.. June 2023...Been playing this for around 8 years, and still love it, the only game with no annoying adverts. However, the creators are getting greedy! Gold pass used to last around a month, now about 2 weeks! Plus, the price has risen!Can't finish it now without paying out more. Free prizes are almost non-existent, and levels are ridiculously hard to do now without paying. Before, they were hard but doable. Sort it before you lose player base. Just read players facebook groups to see!

Advertising misleading, there is almost no escape games, just another candycrush. Waste of time to hope to get to the escape games, really annoying! All advertisements are about the escape parts and yet it is almost no existent in the game. I dont understand the intent behind it. It is just frustrating for those who want to play tha escape games and dont find it.

The game is impossible, it's clearly set so at a point you have to pay for extras which I just refuse to do. Its me at to be a destresser not add to your stresses. Which this definitely does. The items at so expensive which makes it extremely difficult to move onto the next fishbowl. This is coming from someone who actually gave it a chance and is at level 1168. Disgraceful. Not that this will even make a difference or that they will even read this review.

Completely addictive for all the RIGHT reasons. Plus the characters are cuties. UNFORTUNATELY it is a EXPENSIVE game to play - oftentimes the only option for winning a game is to purchase & use combo bombs, etc. - . Past year the game improved immensely - more chances to earn those needed rewards that are helpful in game play. Delightful new aquarium's and characters. Definitely ENJOYABLE experience & endless hour's of ENTERTAINMENT. Great game, thank you.

I am so upset right now at this f game! I never seen such level of greedyness. In the event when you have to cumulate a massive amount of wins (one fail, and you lose it all, we're talking about 42 wins in a row) in other to get some rewards. The event just finished, and they ask me in other to retrieve my rewards to pay up to 60$ of their currency! The hell with your game! I didn't lost, and I already paid money, since this game is insanely hard, and raking up 42 wins in a row is impossible!

I absolutely love Fishdom! I have a number of aquariums now and Fishdom has a number of new contests and new quests that they add on to help clear levels. You can use money to buy boosters but, with patience, the games can be beaten, but now the game gives you ways to earn boosters. I love the variety of fish who all "talk", and make me smile and laugh every day. Decorating each aquarium is lots of fun! I highly recommend this game, so download the app and have fun. I did and I do.🙂

This game is actually really fun. I enjoy how it isn't over ran with ads. Although I noticed some levels they don't give you enough turn so it's IMPOSSIBLE to beat the level without using gems, which the main/only way of getting gems is spending money. Seems scummy to me. If they were to either improve those levels (adding more turns) or make it so you could watch ads to get gems it would be a five star game. I've been stuck on level 86 for days and spent hours trying to bet it. No luck

Too expensive app. Fishy bank for £ 2.99? I tried once, no more. Lot of levels too difficult and if you have no boosters (very hard to get them) you have no chance to level up without pay...Or just wait 2.5 hours to get your lives in full. I really like messages as " Don't give up, you can do it... " YES, ALL YOU NEED TO DO IS PAY, AND PAY AND PAY... Or christmas sale message: unlock the whole picture to get reward. Yes, all you need to do is pay again. At this time £17. Very disappointed...

False advertising! This game is not what is shown in the advertisement. It looks like a fun game where you go through little puzzles to save your fish but instead it is more like candy crush only worse. Annoyed that I have wasted time downloading this. How these companies are getting away with this is beyond me. DO NOT DOWNLOAD IF YOU ARE LOOKING TO PLAY THE GAME ADVERTISED.

Misleading ad sucks you in, i wanted to play the game shown in the ad not what i ended up playing. Then they make the levels near impossible to complete and you have to keep trying, which is fine its a game with less boosters. Or spend money to get more. The boosters are randomly placed throughout the puzzle and half the time you cannot use them, based on their placement, and they cant be moved to where you need them... it became frustrating so i deleted it.

I used to really like the game , but since the last update it has changed ...and not for the better. The bonus' has changed you get less for winning a level...if you can even pass a level.. the energy you get for the expeditions has dropped and the amount of energy needed to continue has gone up. I have played for years but seriously not anymore.. Updates are supposed to add to the games...not take away.

The good: It's a fun and cute puzzle game and I've invested hours in it - nearing level 4k. The fish are cute and the puzzles are quite entertaining. The bad: I've played a bunch of similar games, and while I have no problem spending some money on them, this game and its algorithm are particularly shameless. I could write an essay about it. So it's on its way to be wiped from my phone as soon as this season is over.

I am getting more & more frustrated & disappointed with this game that i once loved. Now just about every level is hard or super hard. The amount of moves are ridiculously low & most of the time half of the moves shown on the Youtube tutorial. I have sent queries to support which take nearly a week for feedback but this does not resolve the issue.

The game is so addictive, firstly it was so interesting, as I was gaining coins, gems a D etc and the challenges were kind of easier. However, as new achievements completed the game became both addicting and boring. Boring in terms of the thing that you don't get coins and gems until you win challenges, and another issue is you don't win advanced challenges without extra supportive items. Furthermore, I was thinking that I will get coins from the fish timely but I have not received any coins.

I have been playing this game for quite some time, the graphics are good, but is now becoming very expensive. you no longer get as many couns when feeding the fish and the 'beauty' points for the tanks is nearly impossible to reach without spending a lor of money. the occasional sale days are lot more expensive as you progress through the tanks, I am getting to tje stage of unistalling the game

Is a great game however the waiting in between for lives in order to play was way too long then you lose interest. Very very frustrating ! Many other games to play that you can play continously. I uninstalled and so has my family. 5* for the fish but 1* for the waiting for lives. They could go for advertisements instead of having to pay..as another option. Angry birds has other options to play while waiting for new lives... More options. So it's a pass for me . Needs improvements. For 5*

I'm re-rating since the season pass has increased, and the game difficulty has increased, thus adding pressure to buy more boosts. The game is now frustrating. Previously, it was almost impossible to complete everything with the season pass at 10.99 AU; now it is 14.99 AU and you get less powerups and down graded power ups in the shells. It's an expensive game when compare it to better quality PC & console games, at a one time cost for the entire game. Shame, it was fun when away from the PC.

After being bombarded relentlessly with ads for this game, I eventually downloaded it. Despite deleting a number of other games, it keeps telling me I need more space to play. Wow, this is a game, not a major programme! I've now read many reviews on here, explaining that the advertised games are just infrequent minigames, and that the gameplay is significantly different- just another match3 game- I'm now going to uninstall this having had no opportunity to play at all, I just won't bother.

I have uninstalled this game because match 3 has been done to death. I don't like them anymore. I only installed it because I wanted to play the eating fish puzzle. I didn't realise that it was going to be mostly garbage match 3. I had the same problem with homescapes & a couple of others. Match 3 was good 20 years ago. You need new game ideas & the fish eating fish is a new & more interesting idea. You really should work on developing that idea more.

Thought that this would be an interesting game that is quite different from most games on the market. False advertising! There are no save the fish puzzles or riddles, just a boring match 3(etc) game. If one could give a zero star or negative star review, that's exactly what I would do! Uninstalling with immediate effect!

It starts off fun but it is not free. It becomes impossible to get to the next level and I have not got money to waste because it becomes ridiculously expensive. For the money you could play on this game you could get a small aquarium of your own. I know I've kept fish. Don't bother. It ends up frustrating because also the tiles will not move as quickly as you want or will stick when you try to get to the next level- total con. A bit fishy🦈🤣

It's a cute game, nothing innovative but good graphics and sounds for a free game. My gripe is that if you don't make a move within 3 seconds it tells you what next to do which completely takes any sense of achievement out of it because you're just being told how to play. It takes more than 3 seconds to look at the whole board! There's no way to turn this feature off either and for that reason, I'm uninstalling as these games are dime a dozen. Shame because I got a little attached to my fish.

Only download this game if you're rich and have a lot of money to waste on buying multiple powerups (which will sometimes even magically disappear without you even using them!) It's a waste of time trying to resolve these issues with the developers because they simply don't care. (Especially if they've already got your money!)

Changing my review....played this game for years but some of the new changes are hot garbage. Challenge levels are frustrating and seem especially created to kill a run of levels and take away momentum as they are nearly unbeatable and the rewards are paltry, somewhat rage inducing and they certainly reduce the fun of the game and the amount of play time. I don't mind a bit of difficulty (been stuck on more than one level for 50+ gos) but the challenge levels are just a kick in the teeth.

It is basically just a match-3 game, like Candy Crush or any of the plethora of other games like it. The other "puzzles" (pulling the bars or eating the bigger fish) are incredibly basic and require minimal thought or skill. This falls in with all other Playrix games that have little, or even nothing, to do with what you see in their ads. Why do you spend so much time developing ads that don't showcase the game instead of actually developing the game?

Not as advertised. Wanted to play a game to save a cute fish. Got match-3. I've played to level 150, got three simple mini-games in the very beginning. Nothing after. Boo. Purchases appear costly compared to other games. Designed to waste them so you'll buy more. Won't get my money. Their other games are similarly deceptive.

A very hard game but cute,only thing I would change is the fact that you have way too many hard and super hard levels after two or four easy levels. Along with a challenge level and too few powerups and to few moves. I changed my rating to one star as it's way too difficult to make it through even using power ups. I have been stuck on a level for the last 2 weeks and used up all my power ups trying to beat the level. I will be removing the game as its just to frustrating.

Fine. But I didn't realise it was dev-ed by the same guys thar made Homescapes and others of the colour-matching sort, so I only installed it because I saw the ad in another game and thought the game was a different thing. It wasn't what I expected. Besides, it's bloody annoying that fishes have cartoonish smiles instead of a more realistic fashion.

Fun and challenging game. Definitely recommend it, but refuse to give 5 stars due to a recent upgrade where you have to purchase diamonds that YOU have earned in game play. Annoying! Additional: Please stop making the achievement of special seasonal characters dependant on movement through the levels!! They should solely be available by "purchase" with the special tokens (eg. bell's in the Christmas event), irrespective of the level you are on! 15/2/19:Each update worsens the game!

From ad, thought it was the game where you move your fish to try to nom your way out. After installing only found out it isn't, but those puzzle type game. Even at lower levels (around 10), already hard to play. So less moves but need to finish so many tiles etc. Forcing us to use all items to clear a stage. Probably AI would be able to clear them all within the moves. Not a fun game at all.

It is very nicely done, addictive, beautiful and relaxing...But it has one huge flaw, which ruins the whole experience - levels are absurdly hard to beat without power-ups, and power-ups, of course, cost real money. I am at level 30 now and I'm already advancing as slow as 1-2 levels a day, and believe me, I play pretty much. If at level 30 it's like this, then at levels 100+ will I spend weeks stuck on a level? Maybe so, if I don't uninstall it first.

I am uninstalling the game simply because it gets too hard to win a level it's frustrating when you spend an hour to no avail. Also when the triangle comes up it always goes to the farthest possible corner it almost becomes useless to have. Especially if you have two of them and try to hit them together it goes so far away from that other one. The game sometimes gets too difficult to play, I mean come on this is supposed to be fun not a source of stress

Pretty good little game. The scenery in each section is quite detailed. The prices for most items are too high. Cute and challenging game. It would be really cool if the fish and other creatures in this app could really respond to you when you talk to them or respond to their questions! This game is expensive; too expensive if you purchase the fish bank everytime you want to collect the purple diamonds or you want to purchase a theme package!😐🐬🐠🐙

I like the game as it keeps me to be strategic in every move I make. However, as the time goes on, each aquarium and even other seasonal events are getting more expensive and unreasonably difficult. You are compelled to buy gems if you want to finish the game however my wallet was finished first before I finished my game. I wish that the golden coins can be used in buying gems through this it can help players manage their games and finances efficiently.

Thought it was something completely different... The advert was a puzzle solving game where you had to pull levers to get the fish through the level alive. But then when I download the app and start it I find out its just a candy crush rip off with an aquarium. Incredibly disappointing that the advert is so untrue to the reality of the game... Especially because based on the advert I wanted to play that - and not what I in reality got.

Really disappointed with the resent changes to this game. For start the price of the ticket events. The ticket event are much shorter time for the same money. You used to be able to collect diamonds in these events that felt like a side hussle, now you are award a set amount. You also used to get set tasks which were an enjoyable challenge. All gone. I can't afford 4.49 for up grades every 2 weeks and without them I get stuck for days. I'm not enjoying it anymore.

Very addictive and well designed app. But really frustrating to have to wait for such long times and so often before you can play again. Use ads to make money as I'm about to uninstall as I have no intention of having to pay for lives as you cannot exchange any coins you've collected and are forced to spend physical cash vs your 'virtual' coins/cash. Still disappointed on how similar each level is...I'm on 33 (originally reviewed on level 20 and the levels haven't changed) 😴

Loved the game!! Been playing for a couple of years now so keep having to wait for new games now, the trouble is it stops you from getting gold even if you beat the treasure game the developers use, you also cannot compete for anything else such as pearls etc. I think the developer should at least let you win gold and compete with others so the game can be still enjoyed as it has started to bore me as it is. Therefore I move my rating from a 5star to 3star.

Played off and on for a couple of months then uninstalled. From other reviews I knew the logic maze games they advertise were a minor part but after 20 levels and about 5 hrs I got one 30 second maze game. The rest are more speed matching with minimal brain work. Then the game insisted I had to buy a certain fish and wouldn't let me do anything else. I wanted to save my treasure for a better fish (IMHO) but there were no options. The whole thing seems quite manipulative. No thanks.

Started really fun, the game is really addictive and the best part is there are no ads. But here comes the tricky part. As you advance the game, it becomes pay-to-play, and as soon as you bought something the game will target you and makes it impossible for you to advance without boosters. Great potential that ended up being disappointing. Also, the last season event, firework festival, cannot be completed without buying gems, since you are running out of giftwrap set. That was the end for me.

Where do I even start? This game is falsely advertised, it's basically candy crush, not the puzzle solving, guide the fish through tu sewers game you see in the trailers. Secondly, the game is ridiculously expensive, and is rigged so you always lose even when you play really well. Absolute wast of time, space and energy. Wish I could rate lower than 1 star. DO NOT DOWNLOAD

False advertising. Gameplay is NOTHING like the ad but is instead a run-of-the-mill M3 game where you have to move shells and starfishes around a board and match them up. With the points you earn you can tidy up your fake ocean home. It's also designed to hook you and keep you playing, wasting your time and thinking the virtual world is important, Tamagochi-style.

For me, I installed it on my Samsung Galaxy, and on my Lenovo tablet, and it was the same glitch. I went to minigames, there was nothing. I tried again, same thing. It also lost my progress. I was on level 20, then my battery died. I went to recharge it, but when I went back into the game, I was on level 5! Uninstalled. Please fix the glitches. Overall, medium, but would give it 5 stars if you fixed the problems.

Average. This game is not anything like the one advertised. It's a form of Candy Crush which is entertaining but not what was advertised. Annoying features include limited lives unless you pay $$ for add-ons but, can be played without and, it wants to constantly insist on team play but, you can ignore it. Minor irritations include the ability to only choose your boosters at the beginning of a game not, when you actually need them, which means you often get forced to use them before you want to.

Game is 10% what was advertised to me from another game. Only thing in common with this game and the one advertised is that it's about fish. I'm not sure how you can get away with advertising something that resembles a escape room puzzle and then the game is pay to play candy crush. But if your marketing team doesn't look into it soon I'm sure someone will sue for false advertising.

What happened to the puzzle style bonus game? The 'adventure' games are blergh. As to the response to my rating due to price - just because u have a basic free option, this doesnt justify more than doubling the price for paid content..... Have u guys seriously doubled the price to buy 10 gems? The price creeping up across all the different areas of the game is definitely making me less inclined to make in-game purchases. And dropping the fishy bank to 30 gems while still charging the same price?

Are a zombie? Do you want to become one? This game is for you, there is a lot of other games that using the same logic and tricks to make you like a zombie. The ads are misleading, the showing of fish stuck in some places need your thinking to solve the problem and save the fish by sliding the correct bar or a mistake would kill it, is not the game, the game is full of BS. Waste of time... Please be smart and play games that makes you smart.

Very punishing game, unbalanced, extremely high difficulty spike, avoid this game. Even if you pay money the game is high risk no reward, the game has an absurdly low amount of turns, sometimes it is impossible to even try and finish a stage. The game forces you to buy more turns by using crystals which can be bought by money... This game is very rough, way to punishing for a casual game. It is even worse than candy crush, please avoid this game at all cost.

I got this game on the pretend of false advertisement about saving a fish. But boy the game I got instead is phenomenal!!! This has been the best game I have ever played on my phone! I look forward to signing on every day. But also because they have beautiful graphics and give their fish such charming and kind personalities. I am dealing with a lot of stress and anxiety, and playing Fishdom helps relieve that. The little fishies and decorations are so pretty. Thank you so much.

Playrix here's a question for you. Did you intend this game for entertainment or to piss off people?? The levels are mighty hard that one HAS to purchase power ups or just spend their time losing and losing, then lose again after they wait on hearts to fill up.... The advertised puzzles are available but only in a parallel universe apparently... It is ALL ABOUT THE MONEY WITH YOU GUYS.. It's not like any review will make you even consider making the game a bit more fun/playable not money hungry.

Do yourself a favour and don't start! Very addictive and expensive. Levels made impossible to beat without using real life money. After spending too much time and money will this game I see it's just a money making machine for the developer. "Please note that Fishdom is free to play, though some in-game items can also be purchased for real money." If you try playing for free, prepare to be frustrated and very disappointed.

Terrible advertisement. It's that tiles game (like candy crush). I'm really upset because when I got the add for the game - it showed me trying to solve a path for the fish to get to safety (seemed a lot more fun) - but when I installed it...it was the tiles game with a few of the advertised games. Please dont false advertise. Its ridiculous. You dont think we will find out when we install? YES WE WILL...AND WE WILL UNINSTALL! 😡

The ad for this game showed gameplay where you have to move rods out of the way of certain blocked off things in a specific order to avoid danger. I've seen ads of this nature for several other apps such as Homescapes as well. Why the heck advertise your game with that gameplay if the ACTUAL gameplay is just a match three and has absolutely no baring on this other puzzle mechanic. Seriously, show me that gameplay is a part of your game. I dare you.

This is not like the ad, you don't gobble up other fish in any way. It's a match 3, with side quests. Kind of like Homescapes without the house to fix. Why they do that is bizarrely puzzling because it's a pretty good game, just nothing like the ad whatsoever. That's why it's getting 1 star. It's fun and all, but blatant lying on their ads is just stupid and deceitful.

Game is fun to begin with but then becomes annoying and boring pretty quickly. levels become to challenging very early (considering how many levels there are) and you burn through lives rapidly and then have to wait 30 minutes to gain 1 life back to try again. if you want more than 1 attempt after your lives are gone, you'll be waiting hours to do it. spend more time waiting to play the game than you do actually playing the game itself.

Money pit! Don't download it! I use to enjoy playing this game, but it has become so hard that you almost want to stop playing. The same levels have on avarege between 5-10 less moves. This makes it extremely difficult and very time consuming. I really enjoy the add ons like the building a tank and the races etc. But it is going to the extent where you can't finish any of those. The gems are also extremely expensive. Impossible to contact playrix.

Soooooo ADDICTIVE!! I've even started humanizing my pet fish😂😂 the game is too cute.. My only suggestion would be to add and create more unique dialogue for each tank! Also, if it would be possible to control the fish dialogue (on/off), that would be great! The chat bubbles are super obnoxious when decorating my tanks & especially when a new item drops into the tank!

I downloaded this game after seeing an ad for it in another game. The advert made it look like a great game where making decisions to move pieces to good a fish through a course to safety. IT IS NOT THAT GAME! This is a match 3 game that clearly has to advertise itself as a definitely game in order to con people into downloading. Why not make the game your advertise? You'd make a mint! I've been reading the feedback regarding the latest version which I've not downloaded due to the misconception that...I too took a double take and had to go out of purchasing the game in play store due to the disbelief that I encountered when I realized that it was the same game as prior, nothing had changed regarding the match up of shapes, bombs detonate if you time out etc etc. NOTHING LIKE THE ADVERT WHICH is a challenger for sharks vs little fish...WHY LIE? DON'T!

It's fun at first but as soon as you get to higher levels it gets frustrating. In order to pass, you need to make lots of power ups and combo of the color power up, or lots of diamonds (have to spend real $) to continue playing after losing all moves. Majority of the levels are less than 15 moves and the tiles needs to be hit 1 up to 5 times. The last few hard, super hard, and challenge levels are next to impossible. Literally spend 1 hour or more on this levels with 1-3 hour life rewards i got.

I, like many long term players am very disappointed with the changes made. The mini games have gone, there used to be fun extras like the bridge game and the collecting gold bars. Now we are stuck with the Atlantis Cup which was OK to begin with but is now boring. I used to buy crystals and other things but as the developers have now got really greedy I will no longer be buying!! Bring back the old format and stop repeating the levels.😡😡

It's what you expect from a match three puzzle game, it contains quite a few microtransactions but I much prefer that to advertisements. Speaking of advertisements I find the minigames you sometimes unlock after a level a complete waste of time for me and whoever had to make them (not that it looks like a lot of time has been spent trying to make them, proberbly less than 5 minutes). They look like they are just there so the game can follow game trends like "pull the pin" type games.

Well. It is not, as it says in the ads, about dragging fish around and eating other ones. It is just another match three, which I am so fed up of, and no one likes. The only reason it doesn't get one star is because the gameplay outside of the match three is quite enjoyable, but to be able to do any of it you must complete the levels, some of which are so hard you get stuck on for days and can't progress. Uninstalled.

Changing my review. There are far too many hard and super hard levels that you get stuck on and use your 5 lives over multiple times. I am now stuck on 902. giving up. Sick of the same stages over and over and getting nothing or progressing. It takes the fun out of the game. Hate that you can't replay the older and easier levels. Wonder if the fish die without being fed? Looks like we're gonna find out.

Misleading Advertisement The Game is okay to play and the control seems to be fun. But the main reason of this negative feedback is that the advert which is shows is completely misleading. As there is no such puzzles in the game. Even after playing 10 levels, I didn't get any puzzles as advertised. Then while reading the reviews, found out that people had played 400+ level but still they haven't found the content show in the advert. Please include some levels as shown in the advert.

I enjoy playing this game but it can be so frustrating sometimes. You have targets on each level, for example you have to collect a certain number of bubbles.. you have 3 moves left and 1 bubble to collect and they're aren't any! You move three times and end the round as incomplete because the elusive bubble or other target piece isn't actually on the screen. This is incredibly frustrating and in my view a way to fleece the player to spend more diamonds, which you mostly have to pay for.

Fantastic game, but the latest update (Jan 2019) has ruined the look of the game board - bad decision. The move of the boosters to the right hand side of the screen was an even worse decision, as I keep accidentally using them when my hand brushes against them. A good addition would be a marker next to items indicating that they have been purchased.

Super fun! Lots of play and levels, no ads, colourful, fun. I like the constant competitions and chances to win prizes. The animations between games feel tedious to me. I'd like the puzzles to just start, without having to see a fish wink at me hundreds of times. Also, I'd like to be able to chose when I claim the reward of unlimited play. I often get it, when I'm just taking a five minute break and can't enjoy it. These are just suggestions, not complaints. The game is great!

I love this game but many of the levels are almost impossible unless you play them 50+ times, use all your bombs and just happen to get a good bomb at the 51st attempt. Kind of disappointed about this. Since the latest update, hard and super hard levels are impossible to complete. Level 4100 is unbeatable, I have failed over 60 times. Instead of the relaxing game, it has become a source of tremendous frustration. So much so, I am seriously considering uninstalling the game!

At first it was quite interesting and addictive as the stages kept opening up. But now it is as though it is made intentionally difficult so you don't finish the game and honestly it's getting annoying. Not like I don't like a good ol challenge but it's getting ridiculously hard and boring as you keep trying to pass a particular stage for hours and then you have to spend money to buy extra lives and stuff. Seems like a market strategy and it has gotten me tired.

Your last update was what kept me as a player! I was frustrated and about to delete the game when you started the task list. What a difference! I'm now able to play longer and earn items to help in the game. Smart move on your part. I'm now a loyal customer. p.s. I also hate the timed levels. Please get rid of them! Two major problems that remain: when I want to play and have time to play, I can't because I have no lives and when I have no time to play, I end up with infinite lives.

I really do love playing this keeps your mind sharp, and quick. Everyone could use that.this would be an awsome game if something wouldn't stop you from making a move of your own instead of a move they want, then it interfears by stopping moves reloading or not allowing you to access a bomb. I can deal with the way the game Is, but when things go missing. and you can't get them back that's bad.I want my fish back. thank- you.

Advertising to this game was misleading. The games that I saw advertised on Instagram weren't a bunch of matching up tiles, they were more challenging and logical games, like trying to free the fish or avoid it being eaten by a shark (you'd know what I'm talking about if you saw the ad). I have kept playing the levels thinking that it would get to that, but all its been is matching up tiles. Going to Uninstall soon because it's getting boring.

Don't waste your time. It was fun at first and around level 89(2 days of play time) it becomes impossible to win without buying boosters or having purchased extra moves. I wouldn't mind paying for the game, but 6.99 only gets you a SEASON PASS. That's pretty damn expesive for a monthly subscription. If it was a one time purchase, I would be on board, but 6.99 a month for a mediocre puzzle game is asking too much. There's many more games like this and I suggest not wasting your time.

Cons: Wish you could choose where to put the boosters that you buy or earn as they always seem to be dumped in the most useless places or in a place that hinders the level. It takes too long to get new lives. A useful addition would be to have an option to buy 1 more move for less diamonds (currently 5 moves for 9) as often just one more move would complete the level. 9 diamonds seems excessive when you can top up your lives for the same amount. Pro's: LOVE this game - very addictive

(Edit:) Since leaving my review in 2016 the game has progressed significantly and been brought more in line with the other games of township and gardenscapes instead of playing second fiddle to them. It no longer crashes and is a perfect little fishie game to play. Lovely game to play but I can't help but feel progress is slow without power-ups. Fish animations and interactions are fun to watch however crash to desktops and not many coins per level completion tend to lead to slow progression.

I loaded this game because I liked the look of the puzzles in the ads. There is a long time between levels, it sometimes moves the wrong pieces, I have to keep shopping which I hate doing and after all the waiting and playing I still haven't come across a single puzzle like the ones in the advertisement. False advertising and pretty boring. Nice graphics, if you like candy crush and shopping, you'll enjoy this.

I want to like this more but some of the levels are just silly. Some of the hard or super hard levels are very easy. Next minute on a normal level you can't even pass it using power ups at the start of the level. Makes no sense. Also I find that it will glitch and not do what you actually try to do. Like you move the object left but it goes a different way or it just doesn't move at all. When that happens and you lose a level because of it, it is annoying. I find myself getting more annoyed.

Very addictive! It's a great game, but I get frustrated at the timed game. Sometimes you end up having to use more extras than I would like, given the restrictions. Also, I've gained the platinum horseshoe several times, but doesn't seem to move forward like the other levels. Graphics are great & love the water movement when you swipe the screen.

TOO MANY TIMED LEVELS!! Love the strategy of the game but the timed levels make me tense and aren't enjoyable and there are far too many. 🙁 Please consider that some of us (me) play it to relax... My favourite game. Play every day! Just one small request.... Please shorten the time to be able to skip level up animation. I don't want it and by the time the skip button comes up, they're almost over anyway! Wasting good playing time, please change 🙏🏾

Originally gave it 5 stars because it's a great game and I don't mind spending the $4.99 for the pass but the levels have been impossible to beat without paying for a cheat. Even the ones that aren't labeled hard or really hard. And the beach ball you get used to help now it makes things worse. The mini games are only at the beginning every 10-15 levels. Now there's none.

I played this game for a year or so. I loved it but as you progress you end up spending money to beat levels, otherwise you become stuck. This wasn't really an issue though because they've added some boosters and mini games to assist with the tougher levels. Don't get a new phone though because your progress won't transfer over, even if it's saved and linked to Facebook. I reached out to customer support, no response. I've deleted the game that I spent money to play. Disappointing 😞

Boring. Also it's not even the same game that was advertised. This is same scheme that Gardenscapes has. They show a game where you're choosing items to fix problems, but it's literally another matching and fix-the-place-up type game. You probably won't get to what was advertised until you're at a high level. I didn't want to do any of this other stuff to get there, so...uninstalling.

False advertising!! Im super annoyed and cross right now as I've just wasted a huge amount of my data downloading something that i thought would be fun and challenging leading the fish through difference obstacles but it turned out to be a match 3 type of game and it's the second time this has happened. Same story with 'gardenscapes'. Very disappointing!!

I truly love and enjoy this game for sure and would recommend it to the rest of the world, but there are some certain things that are not necessary for instance "Beauty Points" are massively high to achieve from the little purchases I make from the store. Complex Levels are becoming more and more by the day which makes me fed up of the game as the days pass, (I've stuck on a level for the past 5 days). Moves are becoming less and less on particular levels. If you could help me I would much love.

The ad is misleading. The ad only comes during the minigame and not the general gameplay. I like it though. Unlike a lot of other stage games, it gives you something to build while beating the stages. I find it a good combination. Personally I don't have time to play the 'candycrush' stages. I only wanted what was advertised. Good concept though.

Is there a chance the chat box could be improved please? Our team is a great chatty one but actually using it is painful. If you make a mistake in your typing early you can't move the cursor, you have to delete the lot. Also can't see once you go past the end of the typing field. Added bonus would be to post screen shots so we can help our team mates, or even revisit old levels. Great game tho. Thank you.

The game is fine. It isn't as advertised though. I was intrigued by the mini-games in the ad. There were about 3 in the beginning, but nothing since, and I've played up to 150 levels. It's an average candy-crush type game while you gain coins and bonuses to build an aquarium. I'd give a higher rating if not for the deliberate false advertising in the ads.

It is nothing like the advert. It is continuing selling you stuff. I would not get the complete experience. I got up to level 63 and stopped as I got increasingly bored. The graphics were amazing and the different types of fish were creative. The game was addictive and relaxing. The colours were bright and cheerful. It is matching three symbols in a row type game. I just wished it was homestead in the advertising.

I used to love this game. Unfortunately, it has become quite exhausting and annoying for numerous reasons - constant bugs, levels that require boosters or additional moves, pushing players to buy gold pass in order to play the game and pass the levels more quickly, etc. Getting people to spend their money has obviously become the main purpose of this game. This used to be such a cool and relaxing pastime...

This could be a great game if it weren't designed to make you spend money. The higher levels are almost impossible to pass, they don't give you enough bombs or lightning. Swapping 2 lightning tiles is supposed to clear all the tiles, but it doesn't; it leaves you with only 1 tile after your last move every time. I stopped enjoying it and deleted. I can find other games!

Game isn't what I saw in the ads. At level 1003 & still no fish to save in tunnels. Graphics are lovely and can decorate different themed aquariums, again are lovely & I enjoy it. But this is an expensive game to buy in game items. I notice when I've paid for more diamonds the levels seem to be beatable whereas not paying is a struggle to beat. I've spent too much & wasted too many hours that could have been spent more productively. Sorry game is a rip off. Good bye.

Obvious statement, but the ads are incredibly misleading. The puzzles are one per day with a 24hr cooldown. The rest is a match 3 game with the normal "decorate a useless space for no reason". Standard fare, they give you an easy ride just enough, and then throw you the levels you can't win without paying. It's predatory and shameful. If it was occasional it wouldn't be as bad but it basically becomes you paying them to win the board constantly, and it's not even guaranteed you can finish it.

I'm not all that impressed. Fishdom is a match three game that is heavily free-to-play. No ads, but the game will squeeze you constantly, making it extremely difficult to progress without spending in-game currency, which not surprisingly can only be purchased. It looks cute, the art is great, and it's well built, but that's all in service of the worst the mobile gaming industry can produce.

I enjoy the game but it ends up being a money grab. The levels get harder and harder and the turns to play get less. Unless you're willing to pay to continue playing you have to wait for time to pass before you can play again. A huge rip off. Got to level 93. Spent days trying to beat it. Finally paid 2.79 to continue, then another 2.79. Only got 3 moves each time. What a waste of money. I enjoy the game but uninstalling because it's a disgusting total money grab.

As all the other review say: it's fun at first but then just becomes an exercise in playing the same level 50 times until the game, or the odds, randomly give you the combination of pieces you need to pass. It stops being fun and there's no skill or strategy involved at all. And this is even with the gold pass, that I've purchased many times. It must be virtually impossible without it. If I may make a suggestion to the company: don't piss off your paying customers. App uninstalled, bye!

Fun and addictive but too long to wait for lives or get through some levels 
without paying. The worst is the lack of bonuses or opportunity to get or 
win them without purchasing them. Alot of money grabbing in this game for 
sure. Also I have tried unsuccessfully for weeks now by uninstalling and 
reinstalling as well as connecting and disconnecting and restarting my 
device; but I still cannot get any lives from fb, which is very frustrating.

Love this game so much! It would help if, once I have earned coins and used them to 'buy' an accessory or a fish, that a green tick would appear by the item so that I'm not duplicating items in each aquarium. Also, I like that the game shows you how many gems you have when you fail a level, but now I'd also like to see a countdown appear when I have earned unlimited lives which shows how much free playtime I have left so that I don't have to keep exiting the level to see how much time is left.

I am past level 5 thousand. Still think it's a very good game. It has many mini games, challenges etc. However i have stopped playing because the beauty points are quite extreme.. You need over 300 thousand bauty points to complete last star in a tank. The decoration or fish that has about 40 thousand beauty points costs about $150 thousand coins. Tops you can make in a level is $2000 coins. You do the math...how many levels you need to play in order to complete a tank? Too much time :/

The game itself is awesome, but the player support is disastrous and totally missing. They restricted some features automatically because of "suspicious" activity on my account. The only explanation I could find was that I simply played too well without buying anything in the game. And that is frustrating for playrix. The, when I contacted the support on the only channel available, chat, they didn't answer. I do not recommend the game.

Fishdom has been updated and now all I can open are the old aquariums that have been completed and the 2 new aquariums that we are forced to play even when they are full. I want to go back to the space aquarium and the list of unopened or new aquariums, but there is no way to do that. Please update fishdom so that we can continue working on new aquariums instead of stagnating in the ones that have been completed.

Love Fishdom! Hours of fun. Well - it was till I got to level 26 which took me AGES to get out - but I did it! Great value (free!), great music and loads of fun. On the PC version my friend is on level 2393! She's been playing it for years 😀 It's now December 2019 and I've been stuck on level 1624 for about a month! I'm just about to give up! No actually it's given me years and years of fun and and loads of people are playing it now both at work and at home. It's a brilliant game!

Love the game. Have been playing since 2017. Wish you would go back to how you used to have the golden ticket though. I can never even get through half the rewards in the short amount of time its available take it back to a month and l and lm sure many others will continue to buy it but as it is now its not worth it. The high levels are quite hard to beat im around level 10415 and l love playing. I have to say its a great game with fabulous graphics

with super hard levels(even sometimes with regular levels) there is no mercy algorithm after many failing streaks. just pushes constantly to spend money on the boosts and packs. an experience of a bitter taste.

Another matching game with a misleading ad. You see the ad you think it's a casual puzzle game where you need make choices to help the characters, as some of the other games marketed the same way (one has a garden theme, the other a town one, a farm one... it's all the same garbage) but just like the others, it's more candy crush-like matching bs. Don't waste your time.

It is really bad game. This game is not relaxing experience. It is real gambling. Actually the game is similar to vegas machines. The machines in vegas never lose and this game never loses. You need to pay real money to stay in this game. There is hard levels and super hard levels which will take away all your booster. And there is challenge levels which will take away your extra three moves.

The math puzzle is lie. I played this game all the way to third tank, just to see if game is unlocked on some part. Also the Fish do not stop constantly over complementing the player. It feels really awful. The art is knock off from animation movie. It is not worst game ever, but it is based on missleading adverticement. I can't recommend game like that.

I Love this game. This fish are so cute. One thing I noticed is that I hadnt pkayed it in a while and when I went into the game, I had to start at the beginning. Not super pleased as I had gotten up to 9 different aquariums and a Lot of fish. However...it is fun to be playing again!!!! So...played for a while but got tired of the fact that once you get up in higher levels, its almost Impossible to win games even with boosters. So..Ive uninstalled. Ive already spent quite a bit of money. Done!

I was at a 5 star review until I've had issues lately and can't get a response from customer support and can't create new chat. Still love the game but tech issues and no response from support has lowered a couple stars

Tired of downloading games after watching adverts that, it turns out, are not representative of game play in the slightest. I loathe match 3 games, but in the past few weeks I've sat through half a dozen of them from this lot hoping to find the puzzle/gameplay that was actually advertised. If it's in their games, I'm at a loss as to where.

I've been playing this game for years - played over 16000 levels. Recent changes to the helps ie bombs etc are disappointing. You now get 1 bomb instead of 2, dynamite with no lightning. Seriously, budget cuts have been made everywhere in life. Games are our escape - why do we need to deal with budget cuts here too? Used to rate it 5 stars but not anymore. Please change it back!!

I've been playing this game for so long. I used to love it so much that no other game can make me happy than this one. From previous updates, i was adjusting to new changes, but now you have changed all boosters like rocket booster and the hand booster. Why??? i want an answer 😕 and colours are so sharp that my eyes are in pain.

Directing this to the dev's response to incessant "rate this game" pop ups, the response indicating that this was because they would like to know players' thoughts on how they felt about the game "from time to time": I suggest you change the pop up to "how are we doing" or "how would you rate us now" and have it in game. That way if a player wishes to click, they will not be taken out of the game and redirected to the play store. And you will have your feedback.

I do like the game but I hate the fact that now everytime you want to go to a new level, you're bombarded with Gold Pass adverts. Even if you click the close button, the Gold Pass story is forced on you and you're stuck in a loop of Gold Pass ads. Please fix that and next time you have the dragon game, make sure it doesn't take 50 dragons to get one thing.
I love this game. I play it everyday. please keep it going. I like collecting cards.

Tried this game in the past (several years ago now). Maybe it's changed since then but this was introduction to "Pay-to-win". This game has annoyed me every since. I couldn't proceed past some levels without paying... I know this because I spent 2 days working out of it was possible to pass a level and deleted it not long after.

Greed ruined this game. Levels get so hard impossible to beat without power ups which u have to buy. Spent at least $50 on this game and just getting worse. U are bombarded with ads to buy specials needed to win. At least when u buy a game it's a one time fee. This game gets expensive if u want to succeed. Totally disgusted and sickened by the money grab.

If you saw the add, this is nothing like it. I finally decide to see what the fuzz is all about, I start a game expecting to eat some smaller fish to become an even bigger fish, And first thing I see is an annoying turtle guiding me through a menu and then a candy crush like game starts. It's all a lie, people. It always is. Now I want to eat the little fish and I have no game to do it with. Thank you for nothing, Fishdom.
one of my favorite games, I love animated games, always attract me🦋🩷

NOT THE GAME ADVERTISED! This is actually a match 3-5 game, where the game ADVERTISED is sometimes unlocked as a minigame. So you have to play some of the most UNIMAGINATIVE "puzzels" just to play the game you wanted to play. Considering how this game is just one huge cash grab(we are talking slot machine like mechanics, and will feed game addicts) the makers definitely just added the minigame because then they technically wouldn't be lying in their ads.

I love the way my fish encourage me, the many different things that can be bought for my aquariums, the special individual ways that the decorations can move when I touch them. The puzzles are sometimes hard, but that adds to the fun. The only thing I don't like is having to buy the Fishy Bank with a Facebook redeem card each time it fills up. The player might not be able to afford to use their own money for that prize (which they have played to earn), nor should they have to.

I have been playing this for 2 years now, hero update & few rules are still not clear to me alty I manage with shield on, but seriously without payment you can't become big player here that's sad rest will play till they keep things good. kindly bring things which can help normal people enjoy the game

The game itself is fun to play...however the amount of moves is simply outages. You have to use your boosters how they are hard to get without spending money. There was a level where it took a whole week to get through. Also they say when you feed your fish you get jewels for extra moves...right. So frustrated with the game I deleted it making it to level 5643. Then you might as well forget it. Oh and one last thing to mention. To get stars for other aquariums the amounts are horrendous.

A great game and completely free to play! You don't need to buy any add ons although it tries to persuade you to. If I lose my lives I leave the game and come back when they are full for free again (30 mins per life or something like that)! I 'win' my bombs etc by beating levels or by the free 'pick a shell' daily bonus. So yes it is completely free to play!! Love it!!

Very addictive pay-to-play. The graphics are pristine, the aquarium is cute. The main game is very addictive, but pretty hard - they know what they're doing, it's very much pay-to-play. Free lives are only awarded every half hour, but even supposedly easy levels are very difficult to beat in one try, often even with boosters. Not nearly enough of the cute mini-games used in advertising to lure you in.

Love this game so many different levels with the added bonus of naming your fish to personalise the game. They also talk to you! The changes that were made with the update a few months back were truly inspired so I can play the chests and build up my weapons to pass the really difficult levels so I don't feel as if I'm getting nowhere. It really shows the Fishdom team work very hard to make their game as interesting and engaging as possible. Well done Fishdom team your hard work shows well done!

it's pretty, it's cute and the match three levels are nice and varied so it won't become monotonous. the option for in-game purchases is there but you can easily play this game without spending any money. I really like it. the only thing that stops me from giving it five stars are the cringey things that the fish say. if the dialogue was a bit more witty and fun not as sickly sweet, I think it would be perfect.

The game is entertaining as the fishes can have conversations and the designs are cool. What frustrates me though is the feature of powerups whenever you make 4-and-above match of the same type of pieces. Bombs effects does not make sense, and there are challenges that are unnecessary. Or probably the game is just not for me. I was stuck in one 'super hard' level for weeks already and I still cannot win it so I guess that's the sign to quit totally.

Great game however if you don't spend money you get anything apart from bored. I enjoyed it but found I got no where. unless you get the purple diamonds you can't buy any bombs and most levels past 500 are impossible without bombs. So sadly disappointing because having to delete as fed up of being on the same level for over a week. Also you need to log on twice a day to feed the fish which is frustrating when you are working long days

You don't have to pay to enjoy this casual game. It's challenging, cute, fun, and easy to adjust to. Take your time with this game; just chill, swipe, tap, decorate, etc.! Maybe adding multi-player to this game would be a GREAT idea? Multi-player being versus modes between/among 2 or more players (or even versus A.I. opponents, like a boss battle where friends and teams could team up and fight a common opponent together? ).

Nice, colourful, exciting game....for the first dozen levels or so, then the player needs to start spending real money to advance through the levels. There are daily rewards, the fish to look at, and there is a timer that allows free tries, so you do have a chance to finish the unbeatable levels.

I love the game but it costs a lot of diamonds to finish a level but takes a long time to save them. I don't believe in paying for them. Why can't we choose when we want to use out unlimited 2hr games on finishing a level. I always get that when it's inconvenient to play that long so being able to choose when I use ur would help. For example at 12am at night having played a game to relax before going to sleep 2hrs of unlimited lives goes to waste. As if it'd B used that time of night, let us have

Not a terrible game, but it's falsely advertised. What you see in the ad is not what the game is like. Also, the game is rigged. You need to line up pieces to pass a level but then they eventually stop giving you the pieces you need. Then you run out of lives and OF COURSE you can get more by using the rare in-game currency or you have to wait before enough time goes by to earn lives or you shell (pun!) out money. And the fish never interact with your aquarium decorations, bo-ring!
FALSE ADVERTISING! not exactly a path puzzle game and definitely not a game where you collect fish and sell them. So tired of ads misrepresenting actual game play.

Update: i have been playing this game since 2017. I am way up high in leveles and now for 2 days i cannot play, the game is frozen or something. Nothing works. I have uninstalled and reinstalled twice and still nothing. Very upset and diappoint as i love the game and have achieved very high levels. But now in the valentines theme, nothing works! Please fix this.
its nice and enjoyable and stress relief game.

The game itself is good, but i have problems with the difficulty in the higher levels. Of course difficulty usually increases when you go higher, but why don't the perks go high up as well. We still have 5 lives even at mid 650. I still get the same rewards when I beat levels at one try as I did in the first earlier ones. As hard/super hard levels come too often as well, I lose lives sooner and it's getting boring to play the game anymore.

Everything a game like this should be. Low on the $ upsells, and you can play without paying. No commercial ads and lots going on. It's fairly simple, cute and beatable while being challenging. Only negative is the puzzle games, which is what it features in its ads. This is a match 3 game, not a logic/puzzle one. They've inserted some very half-hearted puzzles to make the ads true, but they are garbage and should be removed

I thought it was going to be same has all the rest but it's not. It's really addictive. The only thing that I feel that let's it down is the in app items that you have to buy. I thought they would have been like most game apps now that you can purchase by win exchanges rather than having to buy with debit cards.But I love the game and how the fish talk to you . would be even more awesome if you could hear the fish speaking rather than it been wrote on the screen.

I can't run away from candy crush it seems. The advertisements are VERY misleading, and one has to play a lot of candy crush style to progress. Waste. Did I mention I HATE this aspect? And this seems to be the MAJORITY of the gameplay. And not only with this one, all the games from this developer which advertise situation based problem solving.

I played this game for 6 years !!! Is widely advertised as a puzzle game where you have to help a fish out of various traps. This is hugely misleading. What it is is a decent tile-matching game, with an aquarium building game added on - you buy fish and other things for your aquarium with the points you make matching tiles. Very occasionally, you are offered a "minigame", which is the puzzle game they advertised. However, I got to level 200+ and it was still showing me minigames with absolutely no challenge - in fact, they tell you what to do with arrows. It is clear that the minigames are an afterthought. So if you want to match tiles, then it is fairly good. But it is not what they advertise. The other element is that there are things like bombs and lightning flashs that you can earn, which will help you clear a screen. But you never have enough of them, which encourages you to spend real money buying them. The game is engineered to make you think "if only I had a couple more...". I managed to avoid the temptation to spend money, which I think was why I stopped progressing.

This is a very well done, visually appealing free app with no ads. I will add two significant caveats: 1) The ads for this game have virtually nothing to do with actual gameplay. 2) There are a few problems with game structure. The good: There is a good balance of free boosters and gems that make the game very playable, though binging the game for hours and hours is unlikely, even if you are a very skilled player or happen to luck into a series of boosters that allow for it. (That does happen sometimes, but is the exception, not the rule.) The bad: In addition to the game being different than advertised, there are two critiques I have about actual gameplay, neither of which are deal breakers, but both of which are incredibly frustrating when you regularly play the game. 1) The time bombs on some levels are so anxiety-provoking that they negate every ounce of enjoyment the game otherwise brings. 2) You cannot clear what is not on the board! Sometimes goals include clear frozen pieces or "rescuing" squids... and that's fine. However, I can only clear what's on the board. I have frequently played an "extra hard"-rated level and cleared every square of oil, compound coral, triple-boarded blocks, etc.... but I can't clear the level because the squids I'm supposed to "rescue" aren't on the stinking board or there are no more frozen pieces. Obviously, the way to get more frozen pieces or squids to appear is to make matches in strategic places... but sometimes by the time the other [significant] obstacles are cleared, there are only one or two more moves allotted, and making matches to call squid or let pieces freeze puts the player beyond the allotted moves. It's frustrating because it's already a puzzle, which is the point. But, again, I can make strategic moves and be mindful of my move count, but I can only play what's actually on the board. These are just a few points I hope the developers see. Other than that, I would strongly recommend this game. Again, very visually appealing, very good reward ratio, challenges/races, ability to link to Facebook, etc. But, those caveats do matter, so they just a few suggestions for improvement to an otherwise very fulfilling game.
